strings.不冒险，可她一个人在屋脊上，要是生了怎么办（干净水 −2 升，食物 −1000: Don't risk it - but she's alone on the roof ridge. What if she goes into labor? (Clean water −2 L, food −1000 kcal)
strings.不多解释，只叫大家赶紧把筏子扎好: Don't explain. Just tell everyone to get the raft finished, fast.
strings.不带人，请他直接去大堤叫冲锋舟: Take no one with him; send him straight to the dike to call an assault boat
strings.不揭自己的底，但给大家留条退路: Don't give yourself away, but leave everyone a way out
strings.不用下水；就看他自己还有没有力气: No one needs to go in; it comes down to whether he has any strength left
strings.不用干净水，可她背上还有褥疮: No clean water used - but she still has bedsores on her back
strings.不用搜，肯定是他: No need to search. It was him, for certain.
strings.不碍事的，我坐一下就好……就是腰酸。: It's nothing, I'll be fine once I sit a while... it's only my back.
strings.不能动老人的寿材: The old woman's coffin must not be touched
strings.不费一滴干净水；狗要是拉起肚子来，满屋都是: Not one drop of clean water - but if the dog gets the runs, the whole house will be covered in it
strings.不费东西，隔这么远不一定看得见: Costs nothing, but from this far off they may not see it
strings.不费柴、不费水；大人和伢都可能落下病: No firewood, no water - but both the grown-ups and the child could end up sick
strings.不走。水快退了，我守到底: I'm not leaving. The water's nearly down. I'll see it through.
strings.东墙又多了两根斜撑。墙缝里渗出来的泥水，一天比一天多。: Two more slanting props go up against the east wall. More muddy water seeps from the cracks every day.
strings.东边那个湾子，屋顶上原来一家五口，我去的时候只剩两个了。: That bend to the east - there were five of them on the roof. By the time I got there, only two were left.
strings.两个人在急水里翻了几个滚，{actor} 呛了好几口洪水，胳膊被铁丝网划开了一道: The two of them rolled over and over in the current. {actor} swallowed mouthfuls of floodwater and took a gash on the arm from barbed wire, but {actor.he} hauled the man back all the same.
strings.两个人被扶上了划子，万长水用麻绳把他们的手腕拴在了船帮上。: The two were helped into the sampan, and Charles Wan lashed their wrists to the gunwale with hemp rope.
strings.两个人跳进水里，一前一后推着筏子，往大堤的方向去了。: Two of them jump into the water and push the raft, one at each end, towards the dike.
strings.两公里急水，穿着救生衣也不好说；成了，天黑前就有船来: Two kilometers of fast water, and even a life jacket is no promise - but if it works, a boat comes before dark
strings.两年前中风，半边身子瘫了，说话含糊，心里明白。背上长了褥疮，一直躺在竹床上。: A stroke two years ago left her half paralyzed: her speech is thick, but her mind is clear. Bedsores have opened on her back, and she has not left the bamboo cot since.
strings.两暖水瓶开水，烧开的水和接的雨水。缸里那点水已经混进了洪水，不烧开不能喝。: Two thermoses of boiled water, plus what has been boiled and what rain has been caught. The water in the vat is already mixed with floodwater; it has to be boiled before anyone drinks it.
strings.两边的屋顶隔着水喊了很久。: The two roofs shouted back and forth across the water for a long time.
strings.九月初，桂香借了一身体面衣服，把小雨送到了武汉的大学门口。回来以后，她去镇卫生院: In early September Gloria borrowed a decent set of clothes and walked Rainie to the gates of the university in Wuhan. Afterward she found odd jobs at the town clinic and picked up a syringe again. About that packet of parched rice under the rice sack, she never said a word to anyone.
strings.九月初，桂香把小雨送上了去武汉的长途汽车，车开出去好远，她还站在站台上。屋顶上那: In early September Gloria put Rainie on the long-distance bus to Wuhan and was still standing on the platform long after it had gone. For years the village gossiped behind her back about that packet of parched rice on the roof. She never argued, only said: 'All I know is, my girl is alive.'
strings.九月，小雨揣着那张泡皱了的录取通知书去了武汉。临走前，她把那台随身听卖了，凑够两: In September Rainie went to Wuhan with the water-wrinkled admission letter in her pocket. Before leaving she sold the Walkman, scraped together two hundred yuan, and had it sent to Sean Ma's family in Sichuan. In four years of university she never bought another tape.
strings.九月，小雨揣着那张泡皱了的录取通知书去武汉报到。学校给灾区来的新生开了'绿色通道: In September Rainie went to Wuhan to register, carrying that soaked, crumpled admission letter. The school had opened a 'green channel' for students from the disaster area, and tuition could be paid late. On the registration form, under home address, she wrote: Yongfeng Polder, a tent on the dike.
strings.也许换了你也一样: Maybe you'd have done the same
strings.二楼有半袋米、几块腊肉、两瓶开水、一缸混进了洪水的水、几床被子、一堆泡湿的柴火和: On the second floor there was half a sack of rice, a few slabs of cured pork, two thermoses of boiled water, a vat of water the flood had seeped into, several quilts, a pile of soaked firewood, and one big wooden tub. After dawn, everywhere you looked was a churning yellow soup; only treetops and the roofs of a few distant houses still broke the surface. The outside world knew Yongfeng Polder had breached - but tens of thousands of people in that polder were waiting for boats.
strings.二楼的水已经到了膝盖。楼梯上，那头猪只剩鼻子露在水面上，一声比一声叫得惨。德厚蹲: The water on the second floor was already at knee height. On the stairs only the pig's snout was still above water, and its squealing grew worse by the minute. Dennis crouched at the top of the stairs on the roof and looked back at everyone.
strings.云压得很低，一丝风也没有，闷得人喘不上气。: The clouds hung low and not a breath of wind stirred. The heat was suffocating.
strings.人人都要熬夜打老鼠；老鼠尿沾过的东西，碰了就得洗手: Everyone loses sleep chasing rats; anything a rat has wet on means washing your hands
strings.人吃什么，就分它一口什么: Whatever the humans eat, give the dog a bite of it
strings.人歇过来了，划子才稳；可今晚又多一张嘴（干净水 −2 升，食物 −800 千卡）: A rested man rows a steadier sampan - but tonight there is one more mouth to feed (Clean water −2 L, food −800 kcal)
strings.人能救上来，可你会水的事就藏不住了: You can save him - but then everyone will know you can swim
strings.人能救回来，可急水里两个人可能一起没了: He might be saved - or the two of you might both go under in that current
strings.人都不够喝，还分给狗？可它再舔洪水、拉在屋里，人也跟着遭殃（干净水 −1.5 升: Nobody has enough to drink, and you would share with a dog? But if it keeps licking floodwater and fouling the house, everyone pays for it (Clean water −1.5 L)
strings.人都吃不饱，还喂猪？: People aren't getting enough to eat, and you would feed a pig?
strings.什么也不管，先躺下歇一口气: Forget everything and lie down for a while
strings.什么也不管，跳下去救人: Forget everything and jump in to save him
strings.什么也做不了，只能守着他: There is nothing to be done; all you can do is stay with him
strings.从干净水里匀一碗给它: Measure out a bowl of clean water for him
strings.他们一定是被船接走了: They must have been picked up by a boat
strings.他会欠你一个人情: He will owe you a favor
strings.他伸手去够樟树，差了一臂远。门板一转，就被冲进了下游的树梢里。: He reached for the camphor tree and came up an arm's length short. The plank spun, and he was swept into the treetops downstream.
strings.他已经累得快划不动了，划子随时可能出事: He is already too tired to row; the sampan could go over at any moment
strings.他扑过去抱住了樟树，又顺着树杈一点一点挪到屋檐边，被几只手拽了上来。: He lunged and wrapped his arms around the camphor tree, worked his way branch by branch to the eaves, and was hauled up by several hands.
strings.他腿上的伤还没好透；可等下去，谁也不知道船哪天来: The wound on his leg has not fully healed - but if you wait, nobody knows when a boat will come
strings.他认得乡里的干部，兴许真能叫来船；也兴许一上堤就不管了: He knows the township officials; maybe he really can bring a boat back - or maybe once he is on the dike he simply will not bother
strings.他认得水路，比谁游过去都快；可大堤上的船来不来，谁也说不准: He knows these waters and could swim there faster than anyone - but whether the boats on the dike come is another matter
strings.他说中秋回来的。厂里不放假，他会不会偷偷跑回来……: He said he would be back for the Mid-Autumn Festival. The factory will not give him leave, but maybe he will slip away anyway...
strings.伢抽了三天三夜，竟然一点一点地松开了。春梅哭着笑了。: The baby convulses for three days and three nights — and then, little by little, loosens. Cherry laughs through her tears.
strings.伢是生下来了，可春梅身下的血一直止不住。{actor} 跪在她身边，一下一下地按: The baby was born, but the bleeding under Cherry would not stop. {actor} knelt beside her and pressed down on her belly, again and again.
strings.你吃饱一点，她欠你一个秘密: Eat your fill; she owes you a secret
strings.你在米袋子底下藏了一包炒米和两瓶橘子汽水，谁也没告诉，连德厚都不知道。那是留给小: You hid a packet of parched rice and two bottles of orange soda under the rice sack, and told no one - not even Dennis. They were for Rainie. When it comes down to it, you look after your daughter first.
strings.你心里清楚这房子不经泡：当年为了省钱，二楼没打圈梁，墙是用石灰砂浆砌的，不是水泥: You know perfectly well this house cannot take the soaking. To save money back then you never cast a ring beam on the second floor, and the walls went up with lime mortar, not cement. A few days in the water and the walls will go soft, then come down. But you will not let anyone think your house is unsound, and you cannot bear to leave it.
strings.你水性好得很：你在嘉陵江边长大，十几岁就能横渡江面。可你一直说自己不会游泳——你: You are a strong swimmer: you grew up on the banks of the Jialing and could cross the river in your teens. But you keep saying you cannot swim - you will not be pushed out to swim those two kilometers of fast water. Besides, you can guess who took the money: Rainie's brand-new Walkman cost exactly two hundred yuan.
strings.保住秘密，也让大家有个盼头；可收音机迟早还会响: Keep the secret and give everyone something to hope for - but the radio will come on again sooner or later
strings.保住秘密，活着出去: Keep the secret and get out alive
strings.信号断断续续，后面的话被一阵沙沙声盖住了。: The signal kept cutting out, and the rest was swallowed by static.
strings.俺们班长说，人在堤在……堤没守住，俺没脸回去见他。: 'Our squad leader said, while we stand, the dike stands... We did not hold it. I cannot face him again.'
strings.俺娘送俺当兵的时候说，到了部队要听话。俺这回……算不算掉队？: 'When my mother sent me off to the army she said, do as you are told. This time... does this count as falling out of line?'
strings.俺水性中。等腿上这口子收了口，俺就游回去报信。: 'I swim all right. Once this cut on my leg closes up, I will swim back and report.'
strings.倔、不爱哭，夜里会偷偷喊爷爷。: Stubborn, hardly ever cries, but at night he calls for his grandpa when he thinks no one can hear.
strings.借住在陈家的四川砖匠: A bricklayer from Sichuan, lodging with the Chen family
strings.傍晚，{actor} 拧开了半导体收音机。电台里正在播：九江长江大堤决口了，几万: In the evening {actor} turned on the transistor radio. The station was reporting that the Yangtze dike at Jiujiang had breached, and tens of thousands of soldiers and civilians were fighting to plug it... Then the provincial news: '...Yongfeng Polder has breached; troops are organizing assault boats through the night for the search and rescue. According to local reports, the breach site had previously...'
strings.傍晚，大堤上的高音喇叭又响了，一个字一个字地喊：今年第五次洪峰正在通过沙市，沿江: In the evening the loudspeakers on the dike crackle up again, spelling it out word by word: the fifth flood crest of the summer is passing Shashi, the river will rise again, and every soldier is to report to the dike. One by one, the assault boats that have been weaving through the polder these past days head off towards the dike. Outside, the water starts creeping up again, inch by inch.
strings.傍晚，天边压过来一大片黑云。远处大堤上的高音喇叭断断续续地喊：上游又一个洪峰下来: In the evening a great black cloud pressed in from the horizon. The loudspeakers on the distant dike came through in fragments: another flood peak was coming down from upstream, and the river would keep rising all along its course. The storm was almost on them.
strings.先上屋顶挂红被面、写 SOS: First get up on the roof and hang the red quilt cover, write SOS
strings.先把屋顶的凉棚搭起来——这回要在上面熬好几天: Put the roof awning up first — this time you'll be up there for days
strings.先把烂泥铲出去，用开水把地烫一遍: Shovel out the muck first, then scald the floor with boiling water
strings.先活下去再说: Survive first; the rest can wait
strings.先活下去再说，可心里那根刺拔不掉: Survive first - but that splinter never comes out of your heart
strings.光和响动都会让他抽；这是离开医院以后能做的全部: Light and noise set off the spasms; it's everything that can be done outside a hospital
strings.全力把筏子扎完: Put everything into finishing the raft
strings.全力把筏子扎完，房子撑不住就走: Throw everything into finishing the raft — if the house goes, you leave
strings.全村第一个考上大学的女伢，武汉寄来的录取通知书上个礼拜才到，溃口那晚她用塑料袋包: The first girl from the village to get into university. The admission letter from Wuhan had arrived only last week, and the night the dike broke she wrapped it in three layers of plastic and carried it against her chest. Good at her books, knows a little about hygiene - and has never done a day of heavy work.
strings.其他人都上船；德厚一个人留在屋顶上等水退: Everyone else gets on; Dennis stays on the roof alone and waits for the water to drop
strings.内部计数：挑“身体最差的人”时用。: Internal counter: used when picking 'the person in worst shape.'
strings.内部计数：这一趟船已经安排了几个人。: Internal counter: how many people are already assigned to this boat run.
strings.冇得事，裂的是墙皮，这屋结实得很: It's nothing - that's just the plaster cracking. This house is solid.
strings.再加固一遍房子：重东西扔下楼，木头顶住东墙: Brace the house again: throw the heavy things downstairs and prop the east wall with timbers
strings.再等等，船总会来的: Wait a little longer. A boat will come eventually.
strings.冤枉就冤枉吧，先活下去: Let them think what they like. Survive first.
strings.冤枉洗清了，可他也没再多待。第二年开春，马向东回了四川，在嘉陵江边盖了三间砖房，: His name was cleared, but he did not stay long after that. The next spring Sean Ma went home to Sichuan and put up three brick rooms on the bank of the Jialing, laying every brick himself, all with cement mortar. When people asked how his years in Hubei had been, he said: 'I got flooded once.'
strings.冲他喊：抓住门口那棵樟树！: Shout to him: grab the camphor tree by the door!
strings.冲锋舟发现你们的概率 = 救援力度（头两天船都在大堤和集镇上，之后逐渐增加）×（: Chance an assault boat spots you = search effort (for the first two days the boats are at the dike and the market town, then more and more) × (base chance + how visible your signal is) × visibility. At night only firelight has any chance. Swimming or rafting to the dike two kilometers away to raise the alarm is faster, but the current can take you at any moment.
strings.冲锋舟在远处兜了个圈子，船头的人朝这边挥了挥手——看见了！: The assault boat circled out in the distance, and the man in the bow waved this way - they had seen them!
strings.冲锋舟开走了。屋顶上只剩下一个人影，坐在那块红被面旁边。: The assault boat pulled away. Only one figure was left on the roof, sitting beside the red quilt cover.
strings.冲锋舟开走以后，屋顶上只剩下德厚一个人，守着那块褪了色的红被面和泡在水里的家。活: After the assault boat left, Dennis was alone on the roof, keeping watch over the faded red quilt cover and the home drowned in the water. Those who lived: {survivors}. Those who did not live to see this day: {dead}. Later, when the village spoke of Dennis Chen, they said he was a stubborn mule; but they all admitted that when the water went down, he was the first man from Yongfeng Polder to wade back through the mud.
strings.冲锋舟跑了两趟。最后一个人被拉上船的时候，回头看了一眼那栋泡在黄汤里的小楼。{a: The assault boat made two trips. When the last person was pulled aboard, they looked back once at the little house drowned in the yellow soup. {aliveCount} people, not one lost. Afterward they lived more than a month in tents on the dike, and drank the first clean water the army brought in.
strings.冲锋舟靠过来的时候，屋顶上有人抱着一个用汗衫裹着的婴儿，才生下来没几天，哭声比马: When the assault boat came alongside, someone on the roof was holding a baby wrapped in an undershirt, only days old, crying louder than the motor. The soldier froze for a moment, then took the child first. Those who got aboard alive: {survivors}, and the baby with no name yet. Those who did not live to see a boat: {dead}. Many years later, filling in a form, that child always wrote 'Yongfeng Polder' under place of birth - a place long since turned into a floodway, no longer to be found on any map.
strings.几个人一起把猪拖上屋顶: Several people drag the pig up onto the roof together
strings.几个人举着被单站成一圈，给奶奶挡出一小块阴凉。: Several people held up a bedsheet in a ring, making a patch of shade for Grandma.
strings.几个人把寿材从后房推出来，桐油的味道盖住了别的味道。: A few of them drag the coffin out of the back room; the smell of tung oil covers the other smell.
strings.几个人把筏子推出窗口，撑着竹竿往张家那边去。: Several people pushed the raft out of the window and poled it toward the Zhang family's place.
strings.几个人抢先跳上了船，船身一歪，差点进水。战士骂了一句，猛地拉开了油门。: A few people jumped aboard ahead of the others and the boat lurched, nearly shipping water. The soldier swore and slammed the throttle open.
strings.几个人用竹竿抵着死猪，把它推进了急流里。: Several people braced the dead pig with bamboo poles and pushed it into the current.
strings.几个人跳进齐腰的水里，拽绳子的拽绳子，托屁股的托屁股。: Several people jumped into the waist-deep water, some hauling on the rope, some shoving from below.
strings.几个人轮流扶着{protagonist}，一夜没有合眼。: They take turns holding {protagonist} up; nobody closes their eyes all night.
strings.几个人连拖带拽，硬是把一百五十斤的猪弄上了屋顶。猪趴在角落里直喘，德厚拍着它的背: Between the lot of them, dragging and shoving, they got the 150-jin pig up onto the roof. It lay in the corner panting, and Dennis patted its back like a child's.
strings.几块腊肉（很咸，吃了口渴）、一锅剩饭、几个馒头和一包饼干。: A few slabs of cured pork (very salty - they make you thirsty), a pot of leftover rice, some steamed buns, and a packet of crackers.
strings.几瓶没开盖的汽水: A few bottles of soda, caps still on
strings.几百米的急水，拦下了就能得救: A few hundred meters of fast water; stop one and you are saved
strings.刀口一划开，黑血顺着胳膊往下淌。: As soon as the cut opened, black blood ran down the arm.
strings.划子消失在树梢后面。大堤上等船的人有好几万，谁也不知道老万能不能找到管船的人。: The sampan vanished behind the treetops. Tens of thousands were waiting for boats on the dike, and no one knew whether Old Wan could find the man who ran them.
strings.划子离开窗口不到一百米，被一股横流顶得一歪，船帮一下子吃了水——人全掉进了黄汤里: Less than a hundred meters from the window a crosscurrent caught the sampan and heeled it over; the gunwale shipped water - and everyone went into the yellow soup.
strings.划着筏子去两公里外的大堤，让那边派船来接。水流急，到处是漂浮物和电线杆，筏子随时: Raft two kilometers to the dike and get them to send a boat back. The current is fast, with driftwood and utility poles everywhere, and the raft could capsize at any moment; you would be out there the better part of a day. Someone who knows the way is more likely to find the dike.
strings.划筏子去大堤报信: Raft to the dike to raise the alarm
strings.刚收到录取通知书的高中毕业生: A high-school graduate who has just received her admission letter
strings.别惹它，等它自己走: Leave it alone and wait for it to move off
strings.剪子在洪水里涮了两下，拿衣角擦了擦。: The scissors were rinsed twice in the floodwater and wiped on the hem of a shirt.
strings.劈了几把椅子和小板凳: Chopped up a few chairs and stools for firewood
strings.劝他再等等，等船来: Urge him to wait a while longer, until a boat comes
strings.半夜一声惨叫——{actor} 翻身时压到了蛇。: A scream in the middle of the night - {actor} rolled over onto the snake.
strings.半夜，{actor} 翻身时压到了什么滑溜溜的东西，脚踝上一阵刺痛——那条蛇一直: In the night {actor} rolled onto something slick and a sharp pain stabbed through {actor.his} ankle - the snake had never left.
strings.半夜，{actor} 被窸窸窣窣的声音弄醒，看见桂香正把什么东西往小雨嘴里塞——: In the middle of the night {actor} woke to a rustling and saw Gloria pushing something into Rainie's mouth - a handful of parched rice, with half a bottle of orange soda beside her.
strings.半夜，大黄突然炸了毛，一口咬住一条正往被窝里钻的蛇，甩进了水里。: In the middle of the night Goldie's hackles went up. He seized a snake that was sliding into the bedding and flung it into the water.
strings.半夜，奶奶摸索着把{actor}叫到竹床边，从枕头底下抠出一个手绢包，用红头绳捆: In the night Grandma fumbles for {actor} and draws {actor.him} to the bamboo cot. From under her pillow she works out a handkerchief bundle tied with red string: a hundred and seventy-three yuan in small notes. “For you… for university.” She has to catch her breath for a long while before she mumbles on: “Those two hundred yuan… Grandma knows it was you. Don't let Sean carry the blame.”
strings.半夜，春梅咬着毛巾把桂香摇醒了：羊水破了。屋顶上没有灯，没有干净的布，四周是黑黢: In the middle of the night Cherry bit down on a towel and shook Gloria awake: her waters had broken. There was no lamp on the roof, no clean cloth, and black water on every side. The contractions came harder and closer together.
strings.半夜，猪挣断了绳子，扑腾着游走了。德厚追到楼梯口，只看见一圈一圈的水纹。: In the middle of the night the pig broke its rope and paddled away. Dennis ran to the head of the stairs and saw only rings spreading on the water.
strings.半袋米。要用干柴煮成稀饭才能吃，3 斤米大约 5000 千卡。: Half a sack of rice. It has to be cooked into porridge with dry firewood; 3 jin of rice is about 5000 kcal.
strings.压着的地方一直泡在汗里，就好不了: As long as the sore sits in sweat, it won't heal
strings.原型：1998 年长江流域特大洪水。那年夏天，湖北、江西、湖南多处圩堤溃口，大批: Based on: the catastrophic Yangtze floods of 1998. That summer, polder dikes breached all over Hubei, Jiangxi, and Hunan, and vast numbers of people were stranded on rooftops, in trees, and on broken dikes, waiting for the army's assault boats. Again and again the survivors' accounts come back to the same details: snakes climbing onto the roofs to escape the water; water everywhere, yet nothing fit to drink, so those who drank it raw vomited and had diarrhea, and dysentery spread among the flood victims; houses that sat in the water for days until the walls went soft and the whole building came down; helicopters dropping food and bottled water to the people below. On August 7 the Yangtze dike at Jiujiang breached between Sluice Gate No. 4 and No. 5; troops and civilians fought for five days and nights and closed the gap with sunken ships and stone. In July 2020 the water level of Poyang Lake passed the record set in 1998, dikes breached in several places in Poyang County, and once again people stood on their roofs waiting for boats.
strings.去年腊月才嫁到永丰垸。男人在东莞的鞋厂打工，说好了中秋回来等她生。溃口那晚她一个: She married into Yongfeng Polder only last winter. Her husband works in a shoe factory in Dongguan and promised to be back for the Mid-Autumn Festival, in time for the birth. The night the dike broke she was alone at home; she climbed onto the ridge of her one-story house and sat there two days and two nights. Her belly was already big, and every few steps she had to hold up her back.
strings.去武汉之前，小雨把那台随身听卖了，凑够两百块，和奶奶的手绢包放在一起，交到了她爸: Before she left for Wuhan, Rainie sold the Walkman, made up the two hundred yuan, and put it in her father's hand together with Grandma's handkerchief bundle. “It was me. Grandma told me to say so.” Dennis held the notes a long time without a sound, and in the end said only: “Go and tell Sean.”
strings.发黄的米粒摊在被单上，晒出一股酸味。: The yellowed rice was spread out on a bedsheet, drying with a sour smell.
strings.吃家里的黄连素和氟哌酸: Give {actor.him} the berberine and norfloxacin from the house
strings.后半夜实在太渴，有几个人舀了缸里的水喝——那缸水早就混进了洪水。: Late that night the thirst got the better of some of them, and they ladled water out of the vat - water the flood had long since seeped into.
strings.后半夜，{actor} 挑蛇时手一抖，被咬了一口。: In the small hours {actor}'s hand slipped while flicking a snake away, and it bit {actor.him}.
strings.后半夜，一条冲锋舟循着手电光开了过来。战士听说有人要生了，二话没说，把春梅抬上了: In the small hours an assault boat came toward the flashlight beam. When the soldier heard that someone was about to give birth, he said not a word, and had Cherry lifted aboard.
strings.后半夜，大黄冲着草席底下狂叫，硬是把一条蛇逼回了水里。: In the small hours Goldie barked furiously at the straw mat until he drove a snake back into the water.
strings.后半夜，满屋子都是吱吱声。楼下的鼠洞全淹了，田里的老鼠也顺着墙缝和电线往楼上逃：: In the small hours the whole house is squeaking. The burrows downstairs are all flooded, and rats from the fields are fleeing upstairs too, along the cracks in the walls and the electric wires: on the beams, beside the rice sack, on the lid of the water vat — droppings and puddles of urine everywhere. A big hole has been gnawed in the rice sack.
strings.后来听说，赵永福一上大堤就去找了乡里的干部，拍着桌子要船。: Word came later that the moment Eugene Zhao reached the dike he went to the township officials and pounded the table demanding boats.
strings.向东叔叔，你教我游远一点好不好？: 'Uncle Sean, will you teach me to swim farther out?'
strings.含混的老人家口音，常念叨“莫管我”。: A thick, mumbled old woman's voice; she often mutters 'Never mind me.'
strings.听老人的: Do as the old woman says
strings.呜……（凑过来舔了舔小雨的手心，又趴下了。）: Whine... (he comes over, licks Rainie's palm, and lies down again.)
strings.和部队失散的新兵: A new recruit separated from his unit
strings.喊话让他们撑住，有船过来一起喊: Shout to them to hold on, and all shout together when a boat comes
strings.四周都是水，能喝的水却最缺：洪水里泡着淹死的牲畜和粪便，生喝很可能得痢疾——痢疾: Water everywhere, and nothing fit to drink: the flood is steeped in drowned livestock and sewage, and drinking it raw very likely means dysentery - and dysentery can drain two liters a day out of a person, so the more you run, the thirstier you get, and the thirstier you get, the harder it is to keep off the raw water. Past a certain point people scoop up the flood and drink. Boiling takes dry firewood (the wood is soaked, so it has to be dried in the sun first), and catching rain is the cleanest way of all. The rats flee upstairs too: water fouled with rat urine spreads leptospirosis, which country people call 'harvest fever' — high fever, aching calves, bloodshot eyes; the severe forms bring jaundice and kidney failure, and the worst bleeds into the lungs. Berberine won't touch it; it needs penicillin or doxycycline.
strings.四川话，“要得”“莫得法”“老子又没偷”，话少，一开口就冲。: Sichuan speech: 'All right,' 'Nothing to be done,' 'I never stole anything.' Says little; when he does speak, it is blunt.
strings.回四川的火车上，马向东发起了高烧，肚子胀得像鼓。县医院的大夫看了化验单，问他是不: On the train back to Sichuan, Sean Ma ran a high fever and his belly swelled like a drum. The doctor at the county hospital looked at the lab slip and asked whether he had been in the water in Hubei - acute schistosomiasis. He lay in that hospital half a month; the day he was discharged he folded the lab slip and tucked it into his wallet.
strings.回来的路上，木盆被浪掀翻了。{actor} 一手扒着盆沿，一手揪着春梅的衣领，硬: On the way back a wave capsized the tub. {actor} held the rim with one hand and Cherry's collar with the other, and hauled her to the window. Her face was chalk white and she kept gasping, clutching her belly.
strings.回来的路上，筏子在电线杆上磕了一下，春梅一头撞在门板上，捂着肚子半天说不出话。: On the way back the raft knocked against a utility pole. Cherry struck her head on the door plank and held her belly, unable to speak for a long time.
strings.固执、要面子、舍不得家当；认死理，越劝越拧；对外乡人和干部都不太服气，但真到要命: Stubborn, proud, unwilling to part with a single possession; once he takes a position he digs in, and the more you argue the harder he sets. He resents outsiders and officials alike - but when a life is truly on the line, he will fight to protect his own.
strings.圆滑、有手腕、爱面子；习惯发号施令，也真会安排事；心里有鬼的时候，话会特别多，人: Smooth, shrewd, jealous of his standing; used to giving orders, and genuinely good at organizing things. When he has something on his conscience, he talks a great deal and turns remarkably helpful.
strings.在屋顶搭凉棚: Rig a sunshade on the roof
strings.在村砖瓦厂打工两年，话不多，干活舍得下力气。上个月陈家丢了两百块钱，德厚当着人说: Two years working at the village brick and tile yard; says little, works hard. Last month two hundred yuan went missing from the Chen house, and Dennis said in front of everyone that outsiders have sticky fingers. The two sides have barely spoken since. He claims he is a landlubber who cannot swim.
strings.在洪湖上打了四十年鱼，一家人吃住都在船上。永丰垸一溃，他就划着自家那条小划子过来: Forty years fishing on Honghu Lake, the whole family living aboard their boat. The moment Yongfeng Polder breached he rowed his little sampan over, and went two days and two nights without sleep, ferrying people to the dike trip after trip. The sampan is small and draws little water; besides him it can carry only two passengers at a time.
strings.圩堤半夜溃了口。天亮时，水已经漫到楼梯口，还在涨。: The polder dike breached in the middle of the night. By dawn the water had reached the foot of the stairs, and it was still rising.
strings.坐稳哒，莫乱动。划子一歪，一船人都要去喂鱼。: Sit still and do not move around. If the sampan tips, the whole boat feeds the fish.
strings.堆杂物的后房里，停着奶奶早几年就备下的寿材——一口上好的杉木棺材，刷了三遍桐油。: In the back room where odds and ends were piled stood the coffin Grandma had had made years ago - fine fir, coated three times with tung oil. Someone tapped the boards: 'This thing floats. Better than a door plank.' Dennis's face went dark at once.
strings.墙里传出“咔”的一声闷响。东墙从窗角裂开了一道缝，能塞进一根手指，缝里往外渗着泥: A muffled crack came from inside the wall. A seam had opened from the corner of the east window, wide enough to slip a finger in, and muddy water was seeping through it. Everyone looked at {actor} - he had built this house with his own hands.
strings.声音小，湖北话，“不碍事的”“我自己来”，疼起来就咬着毛巾，一声不吭。: A small voice, Hubei accent: 'It's nothing,' 'I'll do it myself.' When the pain comes she bites down on a towel and makes no sound.
strings.多一个人，就多一张嘴: One more person, one more mouth to feed
strings.夜里，孙国庆挨着{actor}坐下，压低了声音：'赵主任，俺们连长说，溃的那段堤: At night Kevin Sun sat down close to {actor} and dropped his voice: 'Director Zhao, our company commander said that three days before the breach some villagers saw muddy water bubbling at the foot of the dike, and when it was reported to the village nothing came of it. Higher up has already sent an investigation team. You're a village official - do you know what that was about?'
strings.夜里，小雨缩在被单底下，耳朵里塞着随身听的耳机。{actor} 盯着那根细细的耳: At night Rainie huddled under the sheet with the Walkman earphones in her ears. {actor} stared at that thin earphone cord for a long time - two hundred yuan, exactly the price of a Walkman. And Dennis was still telling people that outsiders have sticky fingers.
strings.大家决定了：天一亮就选人。: They all agreed: at first light they would choose who goes.
strings.大家围到了奶奶的竹床边。: Everyone gathered around Grandma's bamboo cot.

strings.大家把二楼的重东西都扔下了水，用木头顶住了东墙。: They threw the heavy things from the second floor into the water and braced the east wall with timber.
strings.大家把摔开的那袋东西捡了回来，一样一样地码好。: They gathered up what had spilled from the burst sack and stacked it neatly, piece by piece.
strings.大家把米袋、柴火和被子码到了大衣柜顶上，又把奶奶的竹床垫高了两块砖。: They stacked the rice sack, the firewood, and the quilts on top of the big wardrobe, and raised Grandma's bamboo cot on two more bricks.
strings.大家有权知道外面的事，可谁也说不准后面那句会播什么: They have a right to know what is happening outside - but no one can say what the next sentence will be
strings.大家用火柴棍抽了签。抽到长签的人愣了一下，才被战士拽上了船。: They drew matchsticks. The one who drew the long one froze for a moment, and then a soldier pulled him onto the boat.
strings.大家看着那堆冒烟的湿柴，谁也没再说话。: They looked at the pile of smoking wet firewood, and no one said anything more.
strings.大家能早做准备，可你的家、你的脸面都没了: Everyone can prepare in time - but your house and your good name are both gone
strings.大家都睡不好，守夜的人自己也可能被咬: No one sleeps well, and whoever keeps watch can be bitten too
strings.大家都这样，熬着吧: Everyone is like this. We tough it out.
strings.大黄后来又活了好些年。它最爱趴的地方是门槛，见了穿迷彩服的人，尾巴摇得比见了自家: Goldie lived several more years. His favorite spot was the doorsill, and at the sight of anyone in camouflage his tail wagged harder than for his own family - but come flood season he would squat at the head of the stairs night after night, barking into the dark.
strings.大黄在水里回头看了好几次，最后朝着大堤的方向游远了。: Goldie looked back several times from the water, then swam off toward the dike.
strings.大黄忙了一整夜，咬死了十几只，一只只叼到屋檐边上，排成一排。: Goldie works all night, kills more than a dozen, and lays them out in a row along the eaves.
strings.大黄死在了那年夏天。水退以后，有人在陈家楼顶那块褪色的红被面底下，捡到一个用旧皮: Goldie died that summer. After the water went down, someone found, under the faded red quilt cover on the Chen family roof, a dog collar cut from an old leather belt, a little bell still tied to the buckle.
strings.大黄第一个蹿上了船。战士瞪了它一眼，没说话，往边上让了让。: Goldie was the first onto the boat. The soldier glared at him, said nothing, and shifted over.
strings.大黄舔饱了洪水，回来往凉席上一趴，尾巴拍了两下。: Goldie drank his fill of floodwater, came back and flopped down on the mat, thumping his tail twice.
strings.大黄被拴在了晾衣竿底下，冲着水面哀哀地叫了一下午。: Goldie was tied under the clothesline pole and whined at the water all afternoon.
strings.大黄被牵到了屋顶的另一头，没让小雨看。那一锅肉，有人一口也没吃。: Goldie was led to the other end of the roof, out of Rainie's sight. Of that pot of meat, some never took a single bite.
strings.大黄趴在德厚脚边，没有跟船走。: Goldie lay at Dennis's feet and did not leave with the boat.
strings.天一亮就得出发。推选一个人，游到两公里外的大堤上报信。水里有急流、漂着的房梁和垂: They had to set out at first light. Choose one person to swim two kilometers to the dike and raise the alarm. The water is full of currents, drifting roof beams, and dangling power lines; if the current takes you, no one can save you.
strings.天亮了。万长水歇过来一口气，把划子里的积水一瓢一瓢舀干净，拴在窗棂上：'两个，最: Day broke. Charles Wan got his breath back, bailed the sampan dry one ladle at a time, and tied it to the window lattice: 'Two. Two at most. Sit still and do not move around.' Who goes first?
strings.天亮以后，一条冲锋舟在樟树和漂着的门板之间找到了活下来的人：{survivors: After dawn an assault boat found the survivors among the camphor trees and the drifting door planks: {survivors}. Of the Chen family's little house only half a wall was left, standing in the water. Those who did not make it up: {dead}.
strings.天亮前，屋顶上响起了一声婴儿的哭声。是个男伢，不大，哭得很响。{actor} 用: Before dawn a baby's cry rose from the roof. A boy, small, crying hard. {actor} wrapped him in a clean undershirt.
strings.天亮时推选人选。急流里九死一生，但这可能是最快的办法: Choose at first light. It is a dance with death in that current, but it may be the fastest way
strings.天亮的时候，{protagonist} 不咳了，人还活着。: By dawn {protagonist} has stopped coughing, and is still alive.
strings.天亮的时候，春梅的手慢慢松开了。伢在她怀里，还在哭。: At dawn Cherry's hand slowly opened. The baby was in her arms, still crying.
strings.天擦黑的时候，马达声又响了——还是那条冲锋舟。船头的战士挥着手电：“剩下的，全部: At nightfall the motor sounded again - the same assault boat. The soldier in the bow waved his flashlight: 'Everyone still left, get on!'
strings.天蒙蒙亮。水已经漫到楼梯倒数第四级，楼下的灶屋和粮仓全泡在黄汤里，那头猪拴在楼梯: Day was just breaking. The water had reached the fourth step from the top; the cookhouse and the grain store below were drowned in yellow soup, and the pig tied to the stair rail was squealing. Somewhere off in the distance people were crying on a roof. With the water still rising, what comes first?
strings.天黑前，三条冲锋舟一条接一条地拐过了树梢。打头那条船的船头站着孙国庆，嗓子已经喊: Before dark, three assault boats came one after another around the treetops. Kevin Sun stood in the bow of the first, his voice already shouted hoarse - he had found his company on the dike and led the boats back.
strings.天黑前，三条冲锋舟一条接一条地拐过了树梢。打头那条船的船头站着孙国庆，救生衣上糊: Before dark, three assault boats came one after another around the treetops. Kevin Sun stood in the bow of the first, his life jacket caked in mud, his voice shouted hoarse. He had found his company on the dike, and his first words were not a report: 'There is still a building at the east end of Yongfeng Polder. There are people on the roof.' Those who got aboard alive: {survivors}. Those who did not live to see this day: {dead}.
strings.天黑前，三条冲锋舟开到了屋前。{actor} 坐在第一条船的船头，浑身是泥，嗓子: Before dark, three assault boats came up to the house. {actor} sat in the bow of the first, covered in mud, voice shouted hoarse - {actor.he} had swum to the dike and all but dragged the army's boats back.
strings.天黑前，两条冲锋舟跟着 {actor} 开到了屋前——他在大堤上找到了部队，一路: Before dark, two assault boats followed {actor} up to the house - {actor.he} had found the troops on the dike and led them back, pointing the whole way at the red quilt cover in the water.
strings.太阳毒得很，水面反光晃得人睁不开眼，屋顶的水泥板烫得不能下脚。: The sun was vicious; the glare off the water was blinding, and the concrete of the roof was too hot to stand on.
strings.奶奶会安心；可这句话，你得记着: Grandma will be at peace; but you'll have to keep your word
strings.奶奶含含糊糊地说：“用吧，人要紧。我这把老骨头，到时候拿草席一卷就行了。”德厚蹲: Grandma mumbled: 'Use it. People matter more. When my time comes, roll these old bones of mine in a straw mat and that will do.' Dennis crouched in the corner and did not get up for a long time.
strings.奶奶把 {actor} 叫到身边，把递到嘴边的水碗推开，含含糊糊地说：“我不喝了: Grandma called {actor} to her side, pushed away the water bowl held to her lips, and mumbled: 'I won't drink... leave it for the children... When the boat comes, never mind me, you go first.'
strings.奶奶抓着德厚的手直摇头，眼泪顺着皱纹往下淌。这件事没人再提。: Grandma gripped Dennis's hand and shook her head, tears running down the wrinkles. No one ever mentioned it again.
strings.奶奶攥着 {actor} 的手，攥了很久。: Grandma held {actor}'s hand for a long time.
strings.奶奶攥着{actor}的手，攥了很久，嘴角动了动，像是笑了。: Grandma holds {actor}'s hand for a long time; the corner of her mouth moves, as if she's smiling.
strings.奶奶没再说话，只是把脸转向了墙。: Grandma says no more; she just turns her face to the wall.
strings.奶奶的遗体被推进了急流里，后来再也没有找到。水退以后，德厚在新堤的坡上给她垒了一: Grandma's body was pushed into the current and never found. When the water went down, Dennis built her an empty grave on the slope of the new dike. Later the epidemic-station people said that what spreads disease in a flood is the dirty water, never the dead. Dennis heard it and said nothing at all.
strings.奶奶背上的褥疮烂开了，碗口大的一个坑，流着黄水，一股甜腥的臭味。竹床上的席子被汗: The bedsore on Grandma's back has broken down into a pit the size of a bowl, oozing yellow fluid with a sweetish, rotten smell. The mat on her cot is black with sweat and the damp off the floodwater; she's burning with fever, half conscious, calling Dennis by his childhood name.
strings.奶奶走了，走得很安静，像是睡着了。水还没退，四周没有一块干地方，遗体只能停在竹床: Grandma is gone. She went quietly, as if falling asleep. The water hasn't gone down and there's not a dry patch of ground anywhere; her body can only lie on the bamboo cot. As the day heats up, the flies gather. Someone says under their breath: a body left too long brings plague — it has to be dealt with, fast.
strings.她心里明白，也不会再说第二遍: She knows the truth, and she won't say it a second time
strings.孙国庆二话没说，解下那件橘红色的救生衣，亲手给屋里最弱的那个人穿上，带子系了个死: Kevin Sun said nothing. He took off the orange life jacket, put it on the weakest person in the house with his own hands, and tied the straps in a hard knot.
strings.孙国庆从救生衣口袋里摸出半板药：部队发的强力霉素，防的就是这个: Kevin Sun digs half a strip of pills out of his life-jacket pocket: the doxycycline the army handed out against exactly this
strings.孙国庆冲屋顶上的人敬了个礼，扎紧救生衣的带子，滑进了水里。: Kevin Sun saluted the people on the roof, cinched the straps of his life jacket, and slid into the water.
strings.孙国庆后来被送回了连队，他们班十一个人，回来了九个。第二年他退伍回了周口，在县城: Kevin Sun was later sent back to his company. Of the eleven men in his squad, nine came home. The next year he was discharged and went back to Zhoukou, working on a construction crew in the county town. He wrote three letters to Yongfeng Polder, addressed only to 'Chen family house, Yongfeng Polder,' and not one came back.
strings.孙国庆归了队。那年十月部队撤离大堤，沿路的老乡往车上塞鸡蛋、塞苹果。他胸前别着一: Kevin Sun rejoined his unit. That October, when the troops pulled off the dike, villagers along the road pushed eggs and apples into the trucks.
