strings.所有人都要出力: Everyone has to pull their weight
strings.扁担、竹竿、拖鞋，能打的都用上了。天亮的时候，屋檐边上扔着二十几只死老鼠。: Shoulder poles, bamboo, slippers — anything that can hit gets used. By dawn there are twenty-odd dead rats by the eaves.
strings.扁担砸下去三下，蛇不动了。晚上剥了皮，煮了一小锅汤。: Three blows of the shoulder pole and the snake stopped moving. That night they skinned it and boiled a small pot of soup.
strings.扁担砸偏了。蛇一弹，在 {actor} 的小腿上咬了一口。: The shoulder pole came down crooked. The snake struck back and bit {actor} on the calf.
strings.扇风的人得在太阳底下多站一会儿: Whoever fans them has to stand out in the sun a while longer
strings.打不中就会被咬；打死了能煮一锅蛇汤: Miss, and it bites you; kill it, and there is a pot of snake soup
strings.打哈哈：“堤那么长，哪个晓得是哪一段”: Play it down: 'The dike's that long. Who knows which stretch gave way.'
strings.扔绳子，把他拽过来: Throw him a rope and haul him in
strings.抄起扁担打死它: Snatch up the shoulder pole and beat it to death
strings.把一壶开水和一包吃的漂过去，让她撑着等船: Float a kettle of boiled water and a packet of food out to her, and tell her to hold on until a boat comes
strings.把二楼的重东西往下扔、用木头顶住开裂的墙、拿塑料布堵住被浪拍打的窗口。只能拖延，: Throw the heavy things off the second floor, brace the cracked wall with timber, plug the wave-battered window with plastic sheeting. It only buys time; it cannot fix the house.
strings.把伢抱到最暗、最安静的角落，谁也别碰他，一滴一滴地喂: Take the baby to the darkest, quietest corner, let nobody touch him, and feed him a drop at a time
strings.把奶奶和孩子塞进大木盆，其他人扒着盆沿: Put Grandma and the child in the big wooden tub, and everyone else clings to its rim
strings.把所有的盆、桶、缸都摆出去接雨: Set out every basin, bucket, and vat to catch the rain
strings.把扎好的筏子给他划: Give him the finished raft to row
strings.把收音机放到中间，让大家一起听: Put the radio in the middle and let everyone listen together
strings.把木盆、脸盆、水桶都摆到屋顶上接雨。大雨里一个人一趟能接五六升，有塑料薄膜能接得: Set the wooden tub, washbasins, and buckets out on the roof to catch rain. In a heavy shower one person can catch five or six liters in a trip, and with plastic sheeting you can catch more. Whoever catches the rain gets soaked through.
strings.把柜子里那包毒鼠强拌进米粒，撒在墙角: Mix the packet of rat poison from the cupboard into some rice and scatter it along the walls
strings.把桂香陪嫁的衣柜劈开了: Split up the wardrobe that was Gloria's dowry for firewood
strings.把椅子、衣柜、床架劈开当柴烧。干木头一点就着，可拆一样少一样。: Chop up chairs, the wardrobe, and the bed frame for firewood. Dry wood catches at a touch - but every piece you break up is one you no longer have.
strings.把氟哌酸碾碎了喂她: Crush the norfloxacin and get it into her
strings.把泡过的米摊开晾，能救多少救多少: Spread the soaked rice out to dry, and save whatever can be saved
strings.把湿柴摊在屋顶上晒（大晴天一捆能晒出一份多干柴，阴天少得多），顺便盯着水面，看到: Spread the wet firewood on the roof to dry (on a clear day one bundle dries into more than a portion of dry wood; on a cloudy day far less), and keep an eye on the water while you are up there - shout the moment a boat appears. The roof has no shade at all, and the sun leaves you dizzy.
strings.把米、柴火和被子都挪到最高的地方: Move the rice, the firewood, and the quilts to the highest place
strings.把缸里的水或洪水烧开（用掉 1 份干柴；没有干柴就硬烧 2 捆湿柴，烟大、烧得少: Boil the water in the vat, or the floodwater (uses 1 portion of dry firewood; with no dry wood, force it with 2 bundles of wet wood - smoky, less heat, but the smoke can be seen from far off). One aluminum kettle does not hold much; with the big iron wok you can boil nearly twice as much. Only boiled water is safe to drink.
strings.把被单撑起来，几个人轮流给她扇风: Stretch a bedsheet overhead and take turns fanning her
strings.把黄连素和氟哌酸给病人吃上: Give the sick ones berberine and norfloxacin
strings.抓起晾衣绳扔过去: Grab the clothesline and throw it across
strings.投这个选项的人先上船；被留下的人还要再熬半天，他们会记住这一刻: Whoever votes for this goes aboard first; those left behind must hold out another half day, and they will remember this moment
strings.抢在后面那句之前关掉，只说部队在派船: Switch it off before the next sentence, and say only that the army is sending boats
strings.报信的人: The one who goes for help
strings.抬到最阴凉、最通风的地方，扶着坐起来，守着: Carry {actor.him} to the coolest, airiest spot, prop {actor.him} up, and sit with {actor.him}
strings.抽签，抽中的两个人走: Draw lots; the two who are chosen go
strings.拆下房门当底板，绑上塑料桶和泡沫，做一个能浮起两三个人的筏子。万一房子撑不住，它: Take a bedroom door for a deck, lash on plastic jugs and foam, and make a raft that can float two or three people. If the house cannot hold, it is what saves lives; you can also row it to the dike to raise the alarm.
strings.拆下房门当底板，绑上塑料桶和泡沫，做一个能浮起两三个人的筏子。房子撑不住时它是退: Take a bedroom door for a deck, lash on plastic jugs and foam, and make a raft that can float two or three people. When the house cannot hold it is the way out - and you can row it to the dike to raise the alarm.
strings.拆了大床的床架，往后只能睡楼板: The big bed's frame is broken up; from now on everyone sleeps on the floor
strings.拆家具当柴: Break up the furniture for firewood
strings.拴在阴凉里，不许它再去舔洪水: Tie it in the shade and keep it from licking the floodwater again
strings.拼命挥手，喊“我们这里有瘫痪的老人！”: Wave for all you are worth, and shout: 'We have a paralyzed old woman here!'
strings.挂旗打信号: Hang a flag as a signal
strings.按土办法：灯芯草蘸油烧肚脐，再灌一点糖水: The folk cure: burn round the navel with an oiled rush-pith wick, then trickle in some sugar water
strings.捞上来，割点肉煮了吃: Fish it out and cut off some meat to boil
strings.接着拆门板，慢一点就慢一点: Keep taking down door planks - slower, but so be it
strings.推到德厚头上：“那天是他带人去压的沙袋，他说冇得事”: Push it onto Dennis: 'He was the one who took men to pile the sandbags that night. He said it was nothing.'
strings.推着大木盆游过去，把她接过来: Swim the big wooden tub across and bring her back
strings.推着大木盆游过去，把孩子接过来: Swim the big wooden tub across and bring the child back
strings.推进急流里，免得起瘟: Push her into the current, before she brings plague
strings.搜了一圈，什么也没搜出来。马向东一言不发地把翻乱的铺盖卷了起来。: They searched and found nothing. Without a word Sean Ma rolled up his rifled bedding.
strings.撕破脸，可大家有权知道: Tear the mask off - they have a right to know
strings.撕破脸，外乡人的日子会更难过: Tear the mask off, and the outsider's life here gets harder
strings.撬下了几根门框和窗框: They pried loose a few door frames and window frames
strings.收音机的声音在黑下来的屋子里格外响。: The radio sounded unnaturally loud in the darkened room.
strings.放它下水，让它自己游去大堤找活路: Let it into the water to swim to the dike and fend for itself
strings.整个屋顶斜着往下沉，水泥柱还立着，柱子底下是翻滚的砖头和水。: The whole roof was tilting down, the concrete columns still standing, with tumbling bricks and water at their feet.
strings.新生儿破伤风，到了医院也只是有希望: Even in hospital, a newborn with tetanus only has a chance
strings.新的洪峰还要涨几轮。: How many more rounds the new crest keeps pushing the water up.
strings.日头正毒。大黄趴在楼梯口直喘，舌头吐得老长，牙龈都发白了。它一次次爬到屋檐边去舔: The sun was savage. Goldie lay at the head of the stairs panting, tongue lolling, his gums pale. Again and again he crept to the eaves to lick the floodwater - the surface was dotted with dead chickens, sewage, and a film of oil.
strings.日头毒得像火，屋里屋外都烫得坐不住。有人说，下水泡一泡就凉快了。可这水底下是泡了: The sun burned like fire, and there was nowhere inside or out cool enough to sit. Someone said a soak in the water would cool you down. But under that water lay rice paddies, ditches, and pigsties that had been steeping for days - and every old person on the Jianghan Plain knows what that is: infected water, full of blood flukes.
strings.早上起来，隔壁周家的屋脊上空空的，只剩一顶破草帽挂在电视天线上。: When they got up in the morning, the roof ridge of the Zhou house next door was empty but for a broken straw hat hanging on the TV antenna.
strings.早上量米的时候，发现米袋子瘪了一截。德厚的眼睛立刻瞪向了马向东：“又是你？上个月: Measuring out the rice that morning, they found the sack had gone down a notch. Dennis's eyes went straight to Sean Ma: 'You again? I still haven't settled that two hundred yuan from last month!' Sean Ma clenched his fists.
strings.春梅抱着伢，缩在楼梯口最暗的地方。所有人说话都压着嗓子。: Cherry curls up with the baby in the darkest spot by the stairs. Everyone speaks in whispers.
strings.春梅抱着伢，被抬上了一条过路的冲锋舟。战士把船开得飞快。: Cherry, holding the baby, is lifted onto a passing assault boat. The soldier opens the throttle all the way.
strings.春梅是在县医院生的，一个女伢，取名'念军'。后来她男人没再去东莞，在镇上的砖厂找: Cherry gave birth in the county hospital - a girl, named Nianjun. Her husband never went back to Dongguan; he found work at the brickworks in town. Every August she takes her daughter for a walk on the dike, points into the distance, and says: 'You nearly got born out there.'
strings.春梅没能等到水退。她男人从东莞赶回来的那天，在大堤上跪了很久。后来他在新堤脚下给: Cherry did not live to see the water go down. The day her husband came back from Dongguan he knelt on the dike for a long time. Later he built her a grave at the foot of the new dike and planted a bamboo pole in front of it, with a strip of red cloth tied to it - the same cloth she had waved this way from the roof ridge.
strings.春梅的伢不肯吃奶了。小嘴咬得紧紧的，掰都掰不开；一碰，小身子就绷得像一张弓，脸上: Cherry's baby won't feed. His little jaw is clamped so tight it can't be prised open; at the slightest touch his tiny body arches like a bow, his face fixed in something like a smile. Cherry holds him and calls to him over and over. Anyone old enough knows what it is: the 'seven-day wind' — tetanus, got in through the cord from scissors that weren't clean.
strings.春梅的伢在县医院的保温箱里躺了二十三天，靠着一根胃管和一针一针的抗毒素，活了下来: Cherry's baby lay twenty-three days in an incubator at the county hospital, kept alive by a feeding tube and shot after shot of antitoxin. On the day he left, the nurse said he was a tough one. Cherry named him Zhousheng — 'born of the boat' — for the assault boat that carried him out.
strings.春梅的伢没能活过那个夏天。她男人从东莞赶回来，在新堤的坡上给伢垒了一个小小的坟。: Cherry's baby didn't live through that summer. Her husband came back from Dongguan and built a tiny grave on the slope of the new dike. The next year Cherry was pregnant again. When her time came she walked into the delivery room at the county hospital, and the first thing she said was: “The scissors — have you boiled them?”
strings.春梅的儿子是在屋顶上生的。上户口那天，她给伢取名'舟生'——生在水上，坐着船出来: Cherry's son was born on the roof. The day she registered him she named him Zhousheng - born on the water, carried out by boat. At the Mid-Autumn Festival her husband came back from Dongguan and held his son for the first time in a tent on the dike, crying louder than the baby.
strings.春梅被抬上了冲锋舟。: Cherry was lifted onto the assault boat.
strings.是那个出去报信的人，在大堤上拉着当兵的胳膊，指着水里那一点红被面说：那里还有人。: It was the one who had gone for help who caught a soldier by the arm on the dike and pointed at that speck of red quilt cover in the water: there are still people there. Those who got aboard the assault boat alive: {survivors}. Those who did not live to see this day: {dead}.
strings.普通话夹着方言，说话有条理，常说“书上讲过”“我觉得应该……”。: Mandarin mixed with dialect; speaks in order, and often says 'the book says' and 'I think we ought to...'
strings.暖水瓶、脸盆、坛子，全灌满了开水。: Thermos flasks, basins, crocks — all filled with boiled water.
strings.暴雨下得天地一片白，浪头一下下拍在墙上。上游的水还会涨。: The rain came down until sky and earth were one white sheet, and waves slapped the wall again and again. The water upstream will rise further.
strings.最后一个人被拽上船的时候，房子里传来一声闷响。没人回头。: When the last person was pulled aboard, a dull crash came from inside the house. No one looked back.
strings.最显眼，可要烧掉 1 份干柴引火、1 捆湿柴: Most visible of all, but it takes 1 portion of dry firewood for kindling and 1 bundle of wet wood
strings.最熬不住的人先离开这个屋顶: The one who can bear it least leaves this roof first
strings.最需要救治的人先上船；留下的人要在这栋楼里再熬半天，等船回来: Those who need treatment most go aboard first; those left behind must hold out another half day in this house until the boat comes back
strings.有了大铁锅，烧一次水能多出将近一倍；可水底下全是漂着的家什和碎玻璃: With the big iron wok, one boil yields nearly twice as much; but the bottom is all drifting furniture and broken glass
strings.有人一夜拉了七八趟，脸都脱了相。屋里没有厕所，苍蝇嗡嗡地围着转。再这样下去，所有: One man was up and down seven or eight times in a night, his face hollowed out. There is no toilet in the house, and the flies buzz in circles. At this rate everyone will come down with it.
strings.有人从房檐边舀上来一盆黄水。: Someone scooped up a basin of yellow water from the eaves.
strings.有人把脸转了过去。那边的喊声一直没停，后来变成了哑哑的哭声。: Some turned their faces away. The shouting over there went on and on, then turned into hoarse, wordless weeping.
strings.有人把脸转了过去。那边的手，招了很久才放下来。: Some turned their faces away. The hand over there waved for a long time before it dropped.
strings.有人甩掉鞋，跳进了水里。: Someone kicked off their shoes and jumped into the water.
strings.有人给奶奶擦了脸，把她的头发梳整齐，才把凉席卷上。: Someone wipes Grandma's face and combs her hair neatly before the mat is rolled around her.
strings.有人趁赵永福睡着，偷偷打开了他的收音机。重播的新闻里说得清清楚楚：永丰垸溃口前三: Someone waited until Eugene Zhao was asleep, then quietly turned on his radio. The rebroadcast was plain: three days before Yongfeng Polder breached, villagers had spotted piping at the foot of the dike, and it was never reported. All these days he had been saying the army was coming at any moment.
strings.有人跪在竹床边，一点一点把烂肉边上的脓擦干净。奶奶疼得直哼，一只手一直攥着别人的: Someone kneels by the cot and wipes the pus from the edges bit by bit. Grandma groans with the pain, one hand clutching at a sleeve.
strings.有点发酸，但能吃（也可能吃坏肚子）: A little sour, but edible (it may also give you a bad stomach)
strings.有船停下，就有救: If a boat stops, there's a chance
strings.木盆在急水里打着转漂了过去，周家爷爷趴在屋脊上，一把捞住了绳子。: The tub spun across in the current, and Grandpa Zhou, sprawled on the roof ridge, caught the rope with one grab.
strings.木盆拴着绳子漂了过去。春梅把水壶抱在怀里，冲这边点了点头。: The tub floated across on its rope. Cherry hugged the kettle to her chest and nodded this way.
strings.木盆浮力有限，大人们得泡在水里: The tub can float only so much; the adults have to stay in the water
strings.木盆游到一半就被横流冲偏了。{actor} 抱着一根电线杆喘了半天，只能空着手游: Halfway across, the crosscurrent swept the tub off course. {actor} clung to a utility pole, gasping, and had to swim back empty-handed. Cherry watched from the roof ridge and did not cry.
strings.木盆被浪推着往樟树那边漂，几只手扒在盆沿上，一会儿多，一会儿少。: The tub drifted toward the camphor tree, pushed by the waves, several hands on its rim - one moment more, one moment fewer.
strings.染成粉红色的米粒撒满了墙角。夜里老鼠吃得窸窸窣窣，天亮时满地都是僵直的老鼠。: Pink-dyed grains are scattered all along the walls. In the night the rats rustle as they eat; by dawn the floor is littered with stiff bodies.
strings.树梢那边钻出来一条小划子。划船的是个黑瘦的老头，一边划一边哑着嗓子喊：'屋里几个: A little sampan came out from behind the treetops. The man rowing was a lean, dark old man, and he shouted hoarsely as he rowed: 'How many in the house? I fish Honghu. Two days now I have been ferrying people! Boat's small - two at a time, no more.' When it came alongside the window he slumped over the gunwale: 'First... first, a mouthful of water.'
strings.桂香婶，到时候……您可得帮我。: 'Aunt Gloria, when the time comes... you have to help me.'
strings.桂香拉着小雨跨上了划子，一直没回头。: Gloria took Rainie by the hand and stepped into the sampan, and never looked back.
strings.桂香捏了捏{protagonist}的小腿肚子：“这是打谷黄。我在大队卫生室那几: Gloria squeezes {protagonist}'s calf: “This is harvest fever. In my years at the brigade clinic it laid out several people every autumn — it comes from water rats have pissed in, and it needs penicillin.”
strings.桂香没能走出那个夏天。小雨后来学了医。每年八月，她都要从武汉回一趟永丰垸，在新堤: Gloria did not live out that summer. Rainie studied medicine afterward. Every August she comes back from Wuhan to Yongfeng Polder, burns a stack of paper money for her mother on the slope of the new dike, and tells the whole story of that day on the roof from beginning to end.
strings.桂香用毛巾蘸着水，一遍一遍地擦奶奶的额头和手心。: Gloria dipped a towel in water and wiped Grandma's forehead and palms, over and over.
strings.桂香陪嫁的那口樟木箱子，后来被人从淤泥里挖了出来。里面是一沓给小雨攒的学费，用油: The camphor-wood chest that had been Gloria's dowry was later dug out of the silt. Inside was a stack of money saved for Rainie's tuition, wrapped in three layers of oil paper, not one note wet.
strings.桶摆在了屋顶的角落里，盖上了木板。洗手的开水，一人只能用一小瓢。: The bucket was set in the corner of the roof and covered with a plank. For washing hands, each person gets one small ladle of boiled water.
strings.棺材被抬到了窗口，桐油在太阳底下泛着光。奶奶一直闭着眼睛。: The coffin was carried to the window, its tung oil shining in the sun. Grandma kept her eyes closed.
strings.楼下传来一声闷响，接着是砖头一块块掉进水里的声音。东墙从裂缝处整片往外鼓，整栋房: A dull crash came from below, then the sound of bricks dropping into the water one by one. The east wall was bulging out along the crack, and the whole house was leaning east - it was going!
strings.楼梯口那边的嘶叫声停了。拴在扶手上的猪，没能等到水退。: The screaming at the head of the stairs stopped. The pig tied to the rail had not lived to see the water go down.
strings.正午，屋顶的水泥板烫得不能下脚。奶奶的嘴唇干得起了壳，喊她也不应了——中暑了。: At noon the concrete of the roof was too hot to stand on. Grandma's lips were cracked and dry, and she no longer answered when called - heatstroke.
strings.正在拉肚子的人数，决定痢疾在屋顶上传得多快。: The number of people with diarrhea at any moment determines how fast dysentery spreads across the roof.
strings.死死抱住屋顶上最高的那根水泥柱: Cling for dear life to the tallest concrete column on the roof
strings.死猪卡在了窗口下的电线上，臭味一天比一天重。: The dead pig had lodged against the power line below the window, and the stench grew heavier by the day.
strings.每隔两个钟头，就有两个人一起把奶奶翻一回身。: Every two hours, two people turn Grandma over together.
strings.气温按昼夜曲线逐小时变化（白天 35°C 上下，大晴天能到 37°C，夜里 26: Temperature follows a day-night curve, changing hour by hour (around 35°C by day and up to 37°C on clear days, 26°C at night), and even a person resting in the shade must drink three or four liters a day. Working outdoors in full sun (salvaging, drying firewood, hanging a flag, rigging a shelter) means far heavier sweating, and anyone short of water can easily go down with heatstroke. Once you are on the roof you are exposed to the sun all day: the concrete can hit 60°C at noon, and on a clear day you sweat out nearly 3 extra liters; the old and the young give out first, and a sunshade cuts most of it. In rain, everyone on the roof is soaked through and cold at night.
strings.水一定要烧开了再喝，大堤上已经有人拉肚子拉得站不起来了。: Water must be boiled before drinking. On the dike there are already people too weak with diarrhea to stand.
strings.水位每 12 小时更新一次：上游还在下雨，头几天会继续上涨，降雨让它涨得更快，第: The water level updates every 12 hours: it is still raining upstream, so it will keep rising for the first few days, and rain makes it rise faster; only after the fourth or fifth day does it begin to fall slowly. Past 3.3 m the second floor floods, and everyone must climb onto the flat roof. In the summer of 1998 the Yangtze had eight flood crests: the water may only just have begun to drop when the next crest pushes it back up.
strings.水漫过了二楼的门槛，转眼就到了膝盖。没有别的地方可去了，所有人抬着奶奶、抱着能抱: The water crossed the threshold of the second floor and in moments was at knee height. There was nowhere else to go; they lifted Grandma and carried up whatever could be carried.
strings.水终于退下去一截。二楼的地板露了出来，糊着一层半尺厚的烂泥，泡过的米袋子散发着酸: The water finally dropped a little. The second-floor boards reappeared, plastered with half a foot of muck; the soaked rice sack gave off a sour smell, and the corners of the wall crawled with ants and earthworms.
strings.水要是再涨半米，它就没了: Half a meter more and it is gone
strings.水要是漫上二楼，东西能少泡一些: If the water comes up to the second floor, fewer things will be soaked
strings.水退下去了一截，二楼的地板又露了出来。: The water dropped a little, and the second-floor boards showed again.
strings.水退以后，万长水又回洪湖打鱼去了。镇上给他发了一张'抗洪抢险先进个人'的奖状，他: After the water went down Charles Wan went back to fishing on Honghu Lake. The town gave him a citation as an outstanding individual in flood fighting; he took it home and pasted it on the cabin bulkhead - to keep the wind out. When people asked how many he had ferried in those days, he said he had lost count; he only remembered which families he had not got out.
strings.水退以后，县防疫站的人一个湾子一个湾子地查。永丰垸周围的卫生院里，住满了发高烧、: After the water went down, people from the county epidemic station went from hamlet to hamlet. The clinics around Yongfeng Polder filled up with people burning with fever, aching in the calves, eyes bloodshot — that year, after the flood, the county reported hundreds of cases of leptospirosis, which the farmers called harvest fever. Alive off the Chen roof: {survivors}. Those who never came down: {dead}. In the register the epidemic doctor wrote: contact with floodwater — positive.
strings.水退以后，救援的人划着船挨家挨户地找。陈家的小楼还歪歪斜斜地立在泥水里，屋顶上的: After the water went down, the rescue teams went house to house by boat. The Chen family's little house still stood crooked in the mud, the red quilt cover on the roof faded to pink. They had come too late.
strings.水退以后，有人在三里外的大堤上见过一条瘦得皮包骨的黄狗，挨着帐篷一顶一顶地闻，像: After the water went down, a yellow dog, skin and bones, was seen on the dike a kilometer and a half away, sniffing at one tent after another as if looking for someone. In the end he went off with an old man repairing the dike, who called him Yeller.
strings.水退后，德厚回到那栋小楼。墙上齐着二楼窗台有一道黄泥印子，刷了三遍石灰也盖不住，: After the water went down Dennis went back to the little house. Level with the second-floor windowsill there was a band of yellow mud that three coats of lime would not cover, so he stopped painting it. The next spring he bought two more piglets, and swapped the pig rope for a chain.
strings.水面上只有烂菜叶、稻草和泡沫，什么也没捞着: Nothing but rotten cabbage leaves, straw, and foam on the surface; nothing was salvaged
strings.汪！汪汪！（冲着树梢那边叫个不停，那边什么也没有。）: Woof! Woof woof! (Barking and barking at the treetops, where there is nothing at all.)
strings.没人再提这件事。可从那以后，赵永福说什么，大家都只是听着。: No one brought it up again. But from then on, whatever Eugene Zhao said, people only listened.
strings.没有人再听赵永福的安排了。: No one took Eugene Zhao's orders anymore.
strings.没有人知道小雨后来去了哪里。那年秋天，武汉那所大学的报到处，一直压着一份没人来领: No one knew where Rainie went after that. That autumn, at the registration desk of the university in Wuhan, a freshman file sat there with no one to claim it.
strings.没有干柴，肉是用最后几根湿柴熏了个半生不熟的。: With no dry firewood, the meat was smoked over the last few bundles of wet wood until it was half raw.
strings.没有药，也要勤翻身、垫干的，把竹床抬到通风的地方: No medicine — but turn her often, keep her dry, and move the cot to where the air moves
strings.没过多久，大堤那边的高音喇叭断断续续地喊了起来：洪湖的老万报了信，冲锋舟会先去永: Before long the loudspeakers on the dike began to crackle: Old Wan of Honghu had brought word, and the assault boats would go first to the east end of Yongfeng Polder!
strings.河南周口人，入伍还不到一年。溃口那天夜里，他们连在堤上扛沙包、堵管涌，堤一垮，他: From Zhoukou in Henan, less than a year in the army. The night the dike broke, his company was on the dike carrying sandbags and plugging piping; when the dike went, he and several comrades were swept into the water. He clung to a door plank all night, still wearing the orange life jacket, his left leg opened up by barbed wire.
strings.河南话，“中”“老乡你放心”“俺们班长说……”，一着急就结巴。: Henan speech: 'All right,' 'Don't you worry, folks,' 'Our squad leader said...' He stammers when he gets anxious.
strings.沿着屋檐撒一圈石灰，再把被子卷起来堵住檐口: Scatter a ring of lime along the eaves, then roll up quilts to plug the gaps
strings.泡了水的柴火和稻草，得先摊在太阳底下晒干。: Waterlogged firewood and rice straw; it has to be spread out in the sun first to dry.
strings.洗清偷钱的冤枉，活着回四川: Clear his name of the theft and get back to Sichuan alive
strings.洗清自己，可这家人会更恨你；她要是咬死不认，你就是在诬赖: Clear yourself - but this family will hate you more; and if she sticks to her lie, you are the one making false accusations
strings.洪水里的粪便、死畜和垃圾。泡得越久越脏。: Sewage, drowned livestock, and garbage in the flood. The longer it soaks, the filthier it gets.
strings.洪湖口音，“莫慌”“坐稳哒”“水是有脾气的”，嗓子哑得像砂纸。: Honghu accent: 'Don't panic,' 'Sit steady,' 'Water has a temper.' His voice is hoarse as sandpaper.
strings.派人游过去，把水里那袋捞回来: Send someone to swim out and retrieve the sack in the water
strings.浇在身上也是沾了疫水，只是少一些: Pouring it over yourself still means infected water - just less of it
strings.浓烟升起来了，可那条船没有转向，慢慢开远了。: The thick smoke rose, but the boat did not turn; it slowly drew away.
strings.混得过去就混过去；当兵的心里会犯嘀咕: If it can be glossed over, gloss it over; but the soldier will have his doubts
strings.游出去不到三百米，{actor} 被一股急流卷进了漩涡。屋顶上的人喊破了嗓子，水: Less than three hundred meters out, a current caught {actor} and pulled {actor.him} into a whirlpool. The people on the roof shouted themselves hoarse. {actor.he} never came up again.
strings.湖北口音，爱说“冇得事”“搞么事”“我这屋结实得很”，急了会拍大腿。: Hubei accent; fond of 'It's nothing,' 'What's the fuss,' 'This house of mine is solid.' When he gets worked up he slaps his thigh.
strings.湿柴冒起滚滚的白烟。: The wet firewood gave off thick white smoke.
strings.溺水（游回大堤报信）: Drowning (swimming back to the dike for help)
strings.潜到楼下灶屋，把大铁锅和剩下的米捞上来: Dive down to the cookhouse below and bring up the big iron wok and the rest of the rice
strings.火柴棍抽了两轮。抽中的人愣了一下，才被万长水拽上了船。: They drew matchsticks twice over. The one who was picked froze for a moment, and then Charles Wan pulled him into the boat.
strings.火盆（烘衣服，夜里也是信号）: Brazier (dries clothes, and doubles as a signal at night)
strings.灯芯草一点一点地烫下去，伢抽得更厉害了。: The burning wick is touched to his skin spot by spot; the baby's spasms only get worse.
strings.点一堆湿柴，弄出浓烟: Light a pile of wet firewood and raise thick smoke
strings.点火、挥被面、敲盆，拼命招船: Fire, the quilt cover, the basins — anything to flag down a boat
strings.烧开水晾凉了洗，敷上纱布；两个钟头翻一次身，身子底下垫干稻草: Wash it with boiled, cooled water and dress it; turn her every two hours and put dry straw under her
strings.烧开水煮剪子、煮线，在屋顶上接生: Boil water, sterilize the scissors and the thread, and deliver the baby on the roof
strings.爸妈在广州打工，跟着爷爷过。瘦得像根竹竿，胆子大，就是游不了远。: His parents work in Guangzhou; he lives with his grandfather. Thin as a bamboo pole, bold as they come - he just cannot swim far.
strings.狗会凫水，两公里兴许游得过去，兴许游不过去；从此少一张嘴: The dog can swim; two kilometers might be doable, or might not - and either way it is one less mouth to feed
strings.猪一挣，绳子断了，{actor} 被拖得扭了腰。猪被水冲走了。: The pig lunged, the rope snapped, and {actor} was dragged and wrenched {actor.his} back. The pig was carried off by the water.
strings.猪会水，兴许能游到堤上去；德厚的心血就这么没了: Pigs can swim; maybe it makes the dike - but Dennis's life's work is gone
strings.猪把米拱得到处都是，吃得呼哧呼哧的。: The pig rooted the rice all over the floor, snuffling as it ate.
strings.猪是全家的指望（米 −2 斤）: The pig is the family's hope (rice −2 jin)
strings.现在就用筏子把{actor.ta}送去大堤: Take {actor.him} to the dike on the raft, right now
strings.现在就走：先带最熬不住的两个: Leave now: take the two who can bear it least
strings.现在说这个有么用: What good is saying that now?
strings.用 1 份干柴、3 斤米煮一大锅稀饭：又顶饿又能补水（约 5000 千卡，外加: Use 1 portion of dry firewood and 3 jin of rice to cook a big pot of porridge: it fills you up and replaces water (about 5000 kcal, plus 2 L of water).
strings.用凉席裹好，盖上塑料布，停在背阴的角上，等船来了一起带走: Wrap her in the bamboo mat, cover her with plastic, lay her in the shady corner, and take her with you when the boat comes
strings.用刀把伤口划开，往外挤毒血，再用布条扎紧: Open the wound with a knife, squeeze out the poisoned blood, and bind it tight with strips of cloth
strings.用她自己备下的那口寿材装殓，钉好，拴在门口的樟树上: Lay her in the coffin she had ready, nail it shut and tie it to the camphor tree by the door
strings.用寿材扎筏子: Use the coffin to build the raft
strings.用干净水给她擦身子、喂水: Use clean water to sponge her down and give her water
strings.用开水打湿毛巾擦一擦: Wet a towel with boiled water and wipe yourself down
strings.用扎好的筏子去接: Go and fetch them on the finished raft
strings.用洪水给她擦身降温: Sponge her down with floodwater to bring the fever down
strings.用竹竿、被单和塑料布在平顶上搭一个遮阴的棚子。: Rig a shade shelter on the flat roof with bamboo poles, a bedsheet, and plastic sheeting.
strings.用竹竿、被单和塑料布在平顶上搭个棚子。搭的人得先在太阳底下晒着；可真要上了屋顶，: Rig a shelter on the flat roof with bamboo poles, a bedsheet, and plastic sheeting. Whoever builds it has to stand out in the sun first; but once you are up on that roof, a patch of shade can prevent most heatstroke.
strings.用竹竿和绳子去够漂过来的东西：西瓜、木头、整箱的方便面……也可能是一条盘在木头上: Use bamboo poles and rope to reach the things drifting past: watermelons, logs, whole cases of instant noodles... or a snake coiled on a log. You have to lean out over the water to reach them, and one slip puts you in; and heavy work under a blazing sun is a fast road to heatstroke for anyone short of water.
strings.用竹竿把它挑进水里: Flick it into the water with a bamboo pole
strings.用竹竿把它推远: Push it away with a bamboo pole
strings.用绳子拴着木盆，把一包吃的和一壶开水漂过去: Tie a rope to the tub and float a packet of food and a kettle of boiled water across
strings.病人被挪到了屋顶的另一头，身边只放着一个水碗。: The sick man was moved to the far end of the roof, with nothing beside him but a bowl of water.
strings.白天在屋顶挂红被面、用石灰写 SOS、敲脸盆（要在太阳底下守很久）；夜里打手电、: By day: the red quilt cover on the roof, SOS written in lime, basins beaten (which means standing in the sun for hours). By night: flashlights and torches waved. The more visible the signal, the more likely an assault boat spots this place. Rain will wash it away.
strings.省下力气，听天由命: Save your strength and leave it to fate
strings.省下的水留给年轻人: Leave the water you save for the young ones
strings.省力气；老鼠屎、老鼠尿，就全落在吃的喝的边上: It saves effort; but their droppings and urine end up right beside the food and water
strings.省点力气，那么远看不见的: Save your energy - from that far off, no one will see it
strings.看准头和手劲；绳子不够长，扔偏了就再没有机会: It comes down to aim and a strong arm; the rope may not reach, and a bad throw means no second chance
strings.看准头，绳子不一定够长: It comes down to aim - and the rope may not be long enough
strings.看各人的水性，奶奶和孩子得有人拖着: It depends on who can swim; Grandma and the child will need someone to tow them
strings.看手稳不稳: It comes down to a steady hand
strings.石灰圈没拦住。天快亮时，{actor} 在被子里被咬了一口。: The ring of lime did not hold them. Just before dawn {actor} was bitten in the bedding.
strings.硬是一口一口喂她喝下去: Spoonful by spoonful, they got it down her
strings.离开这栋泡在水里的房子: Leave this house drowned in the water
strings.私下找他谈，看他怎么说: Talk to him privately and see what he says
strings.私下找她要一份: Go to her privately and ask for a share
strings.私下找她：要么你自己说，要么我说: Go to her privately: either you tell them, or I will
strings.种田兼养猪的一家之主: The head of a family that farms and raises pigs
strings.秘密就此没了；可话说出来，心里那块石头也就落了地: The secret is gone - but once it is said, the stone in your chest finally comes off
strings.稳住人心，可墙不会听你的: It steadies people's nerves - but the wall will not listen to you
strings.竹床上空了。好几个人蹲在屋檐边，看着那片水，一直看到天黑。: The cot is empty. Several of them crouch by the eaves, staring at the water, until dark.
strings.竹竿一滑，蛇顺着竿子窜上来，在 {actor} 的手腕上咬了一口。: The bamboo pole slipped, the snake shot up along it, and bit {actor} on the wrist.
strings.竹竿和扁担轮流在屋檐边敲了一整夜。: Bamboo pole and shoulder pole took turns beating at the eaves all night.
strings.竹竿和被单在屋顶上撑了起来。: Bamboo poles and bedsheets go up on the roof.
strings.第{day}天了，吃的快见底了。大黄饿得肋骨一根根凸出来，趴在奶奶的竹床边上，有: Day {day}, and the food is nearly gone. Goldie is so hungry his ribs stand out one by one; he lies by Grandma's bamboo cot and gives a feeble wag of his tail. Someone stares at him for a long time and says quietly: 'A dog that size is twenty or thirty jin of meat.'
strings.第{day}天了，还是没有船靠过来。有人说：再这么等下去，不是渴死，就是跟着房子: Day {day}, and still no boat has come. Someone says: if we keep waiting like this, we either die of thirst or go down with the house. Someone has to swim two kilometers to the dike and raise the alarm.
strings.第一下扔偏了。第二下，{actor} 半个身子探出窗外才扔到，绳子把手掌勒出了血: The first throw went wide. On the second, {actor} leaned half out of the window to make it; the rope cut {actor.his} palm bloody, but {actor.he} got the man back.
strings.第九天早上，水退到了一楼的窗台。部队的冲锋舟挨家挨户地搜，在陈家的屋顶上找到了还: On the morning of the ninth day the water dropped to the first-floor windowsill. The army's assault boats went house to house, and found the survivors on the Chen family roof. Those who lived through that flood: {survivors}. Those who did not live to see this day: {dead}. It was September before the water on the Jianghan Plain drained away, leaving nothing but a thick layer of silt.
strings.第二天一早，小雨红着眼睛走到她爸面前，把随身听放在了他手里。: The next morning Rainie walked up to her father with red eyes and put the Walkman in his hand.
strings.第二天中午，大黄叼着一只死老鼠啃了几口，没过多久就开始抽，口吐白沫。: Next noon Goldie gnaws on a dead rat; before long he's convulsing and foaming at the mouth.
strings.第二天夜里，伢不抽了，也不哭了。春梅抱着他，一直坐到天亮。: The next night the baby stops convulsing, and stops crying. Cherry holds him and sits on until dawn.
strings.第二天早上，{actor} 和桂香谁也没提昨晚的事。: The next morning neither {actor} nor Gloria mentioned the night before.
strings.第二天早上，那条蛇不见了。没人知道它去了哪儿。: The next morning the snake was gone. No one knew where it had gone.
strings.第二天，孙国庆当着大家的面问德厚：'叔，堤脚压沙袋那回，是你带的人？'德厚愣了半: The next day Kevin Sun asked Dennis in front of everyone: 'Uncle, that night at the foot of the dike with the sandbags - you were leading them?' Dennis was stunned for a long moment, then turned and stared hard at Eugene Zhao.
strings.等太阳出来把柴晒干再说: Wait for the sun to come out and dry the firewood first
strings.筏子一下子能做好一大半；可在老人眼里，这是天大的忌讳: The raft could be more than half finished in one go - but in the old woman's eyes, this is a terrible taboo
strings.筏子划出去几百米，就被一股横流掀翻了。{actor} 抱着一块泡沫板被冲进了一片: A few hundred meters out the raft was flipped by a crosscurrent. {actor} clung to a slab of foam and was swept into a stand of treetops, and never came up again.
strings.筏子划出去几百米，被一股横流掀翻了。孙国庆抱着门板在浪里冒了两回头，就被卷进了树: A few hundred meters out the raft was flipped by a crosscurrent. Kevin Sun clung to a door plank, surfaced twice in the waves, and was swept into the treetops.
strings.筏子在一股横流里翻了。人捞回来的时候，已经没有气了。: The raft overturns in a cross-current. By the time the sick one is hauled out, there's no breath left.
strings.筏子扎好了，这是最好的机会: The raft is finished; this is the best chance
strings.筏子扎好了：一扇门板，四个塑料桶，几块泡沫，用尼龙绳捆得结结实实。它浮在窗口下面: The raft was finished: a door plank, four plastic jugs, a few slabs of foam, lashed tight with nylon rope. It floated below the window, rocking gently.
strings.筏子比人游快得多；可筏子一走，房子塌了就没了退路: A raft is far faster than a swimmer - but once the raft is gone and the house comes down, there is no way out
strings.筏子稳当得多，可几个人要在急水里撑大半天: The raft is far steadier - but it takes several people half a day to hold it in that current
strings.筏子还没到大堤，{protagonist} 就不咳了。: Before the raft reaches the dike, {protagonist} has stopped coughing.
strings.筏子靠上了张家的屋脊。春梅是被人架着挪上来的，一路上一声没吭。: The raft came alongside the Zhangs' roof ridge. Cherry was half-carried onto it, and made no sound the whole way.
strings.答应奶奶：等出去了，我自己跟爸妈讲: Promise Grandma: once we're out, I'll tell Mum and Dad myself
strings.答应她：船来了，第一个走的就是她: Promise her: when a boat comes, she goes first
strings.算了，有一袋就够了: Forget it; one sack is enough
strings.算了，现在追究这个有什么用: Forget it; what is the use of digging into that now?
strings.算了，这种时候计较这个干什么: Forget it; what does it matter at a time like this?
strings.管它的，下去泡一会儿: To hell with it - go down and soak for a while
strings.管涌的事还是被调查组翻了出来。十月，县里通报：永丰垸溃口，村主任赵永福隐瞒险情，: The piping business was dug up by the investigation team after all. In October the county announced that at the Yongfeng Polder breach, village head Eugene Zhao had concealed the danger; he was removed from office and placed under probation within the Party. He spent two years tending the pump station on the new dike, and every time the water rose he walked the foot of the dike alone with a flashlight, inch by inch.
strings.米吊上房梁，水缸盖严，只喝烧开的；老鼠见一只打一只，死老鼠用竹竿推远: Hang the rice from the beam, cover the vat, drink only boiled water; kill every rat you see and push the dead ones off with a pole
strings.米没搜出来，倒是从桂香的铺盖底下翻出了一包炒米和两瓶橘子汽水。: The rice was not found - but under Gloria's bedding they turned up a packet of parched rice and two bottles of orange soda.
strings.米袋子和干柴来不及挪，泡掉了一半。: There was no time to move the rice sack and the dry firewood; half of it was soaked.
strings.米袋子底下的破洞和满地的老鼠屎，把上回少米的事说清楚了一半。德厚看了马向东一眼，: The hole in the bottom of the sack and the droppings everywhere explain half of the rice that went missing last time. Dennis glances at Sean Ma and says nothing.
strings.米袋子被吊到了房梁上。墙角确实有几只老鼠在窜。: The rice sack was hoisted up to the roof beam. There really were a few rats darting along the base of the wall.
strings.精明、能吃苦、护犊子；嘴上不饶人，心里什么账都算得清清楚楚；对婆婆尽心，可憋着一: Shrewd, hard-working, fierce about her own. Her tongue spares no one, and she keeps every account in her head to the last cent; she does right by her mother-in-law, and swallows a bellyful of grievance doing it.
strings.累得顾不上了，各睡各的: Too tired to care; everyone sleeps where they fall
strings.红着眼睛点头：明天一早，当着大家的面说清楚: Nod, eyes red: first thing tomorrow, own up in front of everyone
strings.红药水、纱布、风油精和半瓶酒精。: Mercurochrome, gauze, essential balm, and half a bottle of alcohol.
strings.红被面再挂高点。船上的人是看颜色找人的，白的看不见。: Hang the red quilt cover higher. The men in the boats look for color; white they cannot see.
strings.红被面绑在晾衣竿上，在屋顶呼啦啦地飘。德厚用石灰在水泥板上刷了三个大字母。: The red quilt cover was tied to the clothesline pole and flapped over the roof. Dennis painted three big letters in lime on the concrete.
strings.给他水和吃的，让他歇一夜，明早再带人走: Give him water and food, let him rest the night, and take people out in the morning
strings.给自己一个念想: Give yourself something to hold on to
strings.绳子一解开，猪扑腾着游进了黄水里，一会儿就看不见了。德厚一直望着那个方向。: The moment the rope was untied, the pig floundered into the yellow water and was out of sight in a moment. Dennis stared after it for a long time.
strings.绳子扔了两次，都差一截。门板被冲进了树梢，橘红色的救生衣一闪，就看不见了。: The rope was thrown twice and fell short both times. The door plank was swept into the treetops, the orange life jacket flashed once, and was gone.
strings.绳子短了一截。小雨被冲到一棵树边，自己扒着树枝爬了回来，腿上划了一道大口子，喝了: The rope came up short. Rainie was swept against a tree; she caught the branches and climbed back on her own, a long gash in her leg and a bellyful of floodwater.
strings.绳子落在了小雨手边，她死死抓住，被一点一点拖了回来。: The rope landed by Rainie's hand; she gripped it hard and was hauled back, inch by inch.
strings.绳子落在门板上，那个兵一把攥住，被一点一点拖到了窗口。他翻进屋里，第一句话是：': The rope landed on the door plank and the soldier grabbed it with one hand, and was pulled in, inch by inch, to the window. He tumbled inside, and his first words were: 'Folks, which polder is this?'
strings.老乡你放心，上头知道永丰垸溃了，冲锋舟正一条一条往这边调。: Don't you worry, folks - the higher-ups know Yongfeng Polder has breached, and assault boats are being sent this way one after another.
strings.老人、孩子、孕妇和身体最差的人先走: The old, the children, the pregnant, and the weakest go first
strings.老人家最熬不住渴: The old cannot hold out against thirst
strings.老人讲的话，宁可信其有: Better to believe what the old ones say
strings.老头一口气喝了大半壶水，靠着墙就睡着了，手里还攥着桨。: The old man drank most of a kettle of water in one go, then fell asleep against the wall with the oar still in his hand.
strings.老头抹了一把脸，咬着牙又握住了桨。: The old man wiped his face, gritted his teeth, and took up the oar again.
strings.老头点点头，喝了两口水，又把船头掉了过去。: The old man nodded, drank two mouthfuls, and turned the bow back around.
strings.老头缓过一口气，从船舱里摸出一块明矾递过来：'打一下矾，水能清些。烧还是要烧的。: The old man got his breath back, fished a lump of alum out of the cabin and handed it over: 'A little alum will settle the water. You still have to boil it.'
strings.老实、能吃苦、好面子；把“解放军”三个字看得比命重，自己伤着也要抢着干活；惦记着: Honest, hard-working, proud. He holds the word 'PLA' dearer than his own life, and works himself ragged even with an injury; he misses his lost comrades and his squad leader, and at night he has quietly wiped his eyes alone.
strings.老的、小的、怀着伢的先走: The old, the little ones, and the pregnant go first
strings.老辈人的法子，不一定管用；石灰泡了水还会烧手: An old folks' remedy that may not work; and lime mixed with water burns the hands
strings.老辈人讲的“新法接生”：剪子不煮，伢会得七日风（干柴 −1，干净水 −3 升）: The old people's 'new method' delivery: if the scissors are not boiled, the baby gets lockjaw (dry firewood −1, clean water −3 L)
strings.老辈人都怕这个: The old folk all fear it
strings.老辈人都这么干；可刀口本身就是一道新伤，四周全是脏水，很容易烂: It's what the old folks always did - but the cut is a fresh wound in itself, and with filthy water all around it can easily fester
strings.老辈人都这么治: It's how the old people always treated it
strings.老鼠也是逃命的，随它们去: The rats are running for their lives too. Leave them be
strings.聪明、要强、有主见；在大人面前会忍着，被逼急了说话很冲；心里怕得要命，嘴上不认。: Clever, proud, strong-willed. She holds herself in around adults, and when pushed too far she talks back sharp; she is frightened half to death inside, and will not admit it.
strings.肉是肉，可泡了一两天的死猪……（要烧掉 1 份干柴）: Meat is meat, but a pig that has been dead in the water a day or two... (costs 1 portion of dry firewood)
strings.肉煮了很久，还是有一股怪味。没人说话，都低着头吃。: The meat had been boiled a long time and still tasted strange. No one spoke; everyone ate with their heads down.
strings.肉能吃好多顿（要 1 份干柴）；德厚绝不会答应: The meat will last many meals (needs 1 portion of dry firewood); Dennis will never agree
strings.能做的只有这些: It's all that can be done
strings.能劈的都劈了，剩下的只有砖头和水泥: Everything that could be split has been split; what is left is brick and concrete
strings.能吃上好多顿（要烧掉 1 份干柴），可这是德厚家最值钱的东西，是给小雨交学费的钱: It will last many meals (costs 1 portion of dry firewood) - but it is the most valuable thing in Dennis's house, the money for Rainie's tuition
strings.能多引旺一捆湿柴（湿柴 −3，干柴 +3.3）；小雨会恨你一辈子: It will get one more bundle of wet wood burning (wet wood −3, dry wood +3.3); Rainie will hate you for the rest of her life
strings.能大大减少传染，但每天的柴火更紧: It will cut the spread of disease a great deal, but firewood gets tighter every day
strings.能帮他们撑一阵（食物 −1500 千卡，水 −3 升）: It will help them hold on for a while (food −1500 kcal, water −3 L)
strings.能直接点着的柴。一份能烧开一壶水或煮一锅稀饭。: Firewood that lights straight away. One portion boils a kettle of water or cooks a pot of porridge.
strings.能防传染，可病人会觉得被嫌弃: It guards against infection - but the sick one will feel shunned
strings.能顶好几顿（要烧掉 1 份干柴或 2 捆湿柴，没柴就只能半生不熟地吃）；小雨和德: It will stretch for several meals (costs 1 portion of dry firewood or 2 bundles of wet wood; with no wood at all it has to be eaten half raw); Rainie and Dennis will never forgive this
strings.脸盆敲得震天响，手电光在水面上一圈一圈地晃。: The washbasins were beaten until the racket was deafening, and the flashlight beam swung in circles across the water.
strings.脸盆敲瘪了，嗓子喊哑了，也没有船来。天快亮时，伢还是在屋顶上生了下来。: The basins were beaten out of shape and their voices shouted hoarse, and still no boat came. Just before dawn the baby was born on the roof after all.
strings.脸盆都敲瘪了，那条船还是开远了。: They beat the basins out of shape, and the boat still drew away.
strings.腼腆、能忍、不愿意给人添麻烦；一说起男人和肚子里的伢就掉眼泪；真到了要命的时候，: Shy, long-suffering, hates to be a burden; she cries whenever she talks about her husband and the baby inside her, but when it truly comes to life and death she is harder than anyone.
strings.自己家的人都快撑不住了: Your own people can barely hold on as it is
strings.自己都顾不过来了，别管: You can barely look after your own; leave it
strings.舀洪水给她擦干净: Scoop up floodwater and wash her clean
strings.船一加速，{actor} 被甩脱了手，喝了一肚子洪水才游回来。: The boat picked up speed, {actor}'s grip was torn loose, and {actor.he} swallowed a bellyful of floodwater before swimming back.
strings.船一加速，{actor} 被甩脱了手，在螺旋桨卷起的浪里翻了两下，就不见了。: The boat picked up speed, {actor}'s grip was torn loose, {actor.he} tumbled twice in the wash of the propeller, and was gone.
strings.船尾的白浪拐过了树梢。: The white wake behind the boat rounded the treetops.
strings.船把活着的人带到了大堤上：{survivors}。留在那栋小楼里的，还有 {de: The boat carried the living to the dike: {survivors}. Left behind in that little house: {dead}. Many years later, none of them wanted to talk about the choices made on the roof that summer.
strings.船超载了，扒在船边一路泡过去也很危险: The boat is overloaded; clinging to its side for the whole crossing is dangerous too
strings.药只有这么一点: There is only this much medicine
strings.药片碾碎了，和着开水灌了下去。: The tablets are crushed and washed down with boiled water.
strings.药片碾碎了，用开水冲着喂了下去。: The pills were crushed and fed to him in boiled water.
strings.药粉化在开水里，一勺一勺喂了下去。: The powder is dissolved in boiled water and spooned in.
strings.莫慌。水是有脾气的，你顺着它，它就不收你。: Don't panic. Water has a temper. Go with it, and it will not take you.
strings.莫管我……先顾伢们。: 'Never mind me... look after the children first.'
strings.蛇在石灰圈外面打转，没有爬进来。: The snake circled outside the ring of lime and did not come in.
strings.蛇被挑起来甩进了水里，打了个旋游走了。: The snake was flicked up and flung into the water; it spun once and swam off.
strings.蛇顺着竹竿窜了上来，在 {actor} 的手背上咬了一口。: The snake shot up the bamboo pole and bit {actor} on the back of the hand.
strings.袋子里可能有药和水；急水里游三十米也不是闹着玩的: There may be medicine and water in the sack; and swimming thirty meters in that current is no joke
strings.装作没看见: Pretend not to have seen it
strings.装作没看见——当妈的，谁不护着自己的伢: Pretend not to have seen it - what mother does not protect her own child?
strings.要一个水性好的人冒险；接过来就多一张嘴吃饭喝水: It takes a strong swimmer to risk it; and taking her in means one more mouth to feed and water
strings.要几个壮劳力，弄不好会伤人；上了屋顶，猪也要地方、要喝水: It takes several strong men, and someone could get hurt; and up on the roof the pig needs space, and water
strings.要强、怕拖累儿孙。: Proud, and afraid of being a burden to her children and grandchildren.
strings.要是真的，他就是害大家落到这一步的人: If it is true, he is the man who brought them all to this
strings.要是那天把伢接过来就好了: If only they had brought the child over that day
strings.要烧掉 1 份干柴，少招点病: Costs 1 portion of dry firewood, and keeps some sickness away
strings.要用掉 1 份干柴；上了屋顶就烧不成了: Uses 1 unit of dry firewood; once you're on the roof you can't boil anything
strings.要用掉 1 份药和纱布: Uses 1 unit of medicine and gauze
strings.要用掉 2 升干净水；人得一直平躺着别动: Uses 2 L of clean water, and {actor.he} has to lie flat and keep still
strings.解开绳子，让它自己游: Untie the rope and let it swim for itself
strings.认了：“是我。我怕挨处分，没往上报。”: He owned up: 'It was me. I was afraid of being disciplined, so I never reported it.'
strings.认人，最护着小雨和奶奶；对生人和蛇凶得很；热了就吐着舌头到处找阴凉，渴急了会去舔: He knows his people, and guards Rainie and Grandma above all; he is fierce with strangers and with snakes; when it is hot he lolls his tongue and hunts for shade, and when he is desperate with thirst he licks the floodwater; at night he pricks up his ears at the slightest sound.
strings.让{actor.ta}躺着别动，把被咬的手脚用木板固定住，一口一口喂干净水: Keep {actor.him} lying still, splint the bitten limb with a board, and feed {actor.him} clean water mouthful by mouthful
strings.让他带着救生衣游回去报信: Let him take the life jacket and swim back to raise the alarm
strings.让他把救生衣留给屋里最弱的人: Have him leave the life jacket for the weakest person in the house
strings.让女儿小雨活着出去: Get her daughter Rainie out alive
strings.让她难堪，可也许能弄清那两百块的事: It will embarrass her - but it may clear up the business of the two hundred yuan
strings.让小雨和她妈先走: Let Rainie and her mother go first
strings.让懂护理的人守着：一口一口喂烧开的水，冷水擦身退烧: Have whoever knows nursing sit with {actor.him}: boiled water a sip at a time, sponge {actor.him} down to bring the fever down
strings.让水性最好的人扒住船帮，跟到大堤上去报信: Have the strongest swimmer cling to the boat and go with it to the dike to raise the alarm
strings.让水性最好的人游过去拦船: Have the strongest swimmer go out and flag down a boat
strings.让病人待到另一头去，离大家远点: Keep the sick one at the other end, away from everyone
strings.让船先去救别家，我们守着房子等水退: Let the boat go and save other families first; we keep the house and wait for the water to drop
strings.让赵主任先走：他说要去堤上组织救人: Let Director Zhao go first: he says he has to get to the dike and organize the rescue
strings.让路过的船早点看见这里: Make passing boats see this place sooner
strings.话少、倔、心善；信水里有水神，船上从不说“翻”“沉”这些字；看不惯哭哭啼啼，更看: Says little, stubborn, kind-hearted. He believes there is a water god in the river and never says the words 'capsize' or 'sink' aboard his boat; he cannot stand weeping and wailing, and he cannot stand people fighting to leave first; even at the end of his strength he keeps going.
strings.说不定是老鼠——水一淹，老鼠全往楼上跑: Maybe it is rats - when the water rises, the rats all run upstairs
strings.说出来，向东就清白了；爸妈会怎么看你，就不知道了: Say it and Sean is cleared; how Mum and Dad will look at you is another matter
strings.说实话：墙是石灰砂浆砌的，泡久了会塌: Tell the truth: the walls are laid with lime mortar and will come down after a long soaking
strings.说没电了，把收音机收起来: Say the batteries are dead and put the radio away
strings.说话快，爱念叨“作孽哟”“我跟你讲”，安排起事情来像在吵架。: Talks fast; always saying 'Such misery' and 'I tell you'; when she is organizing something it sounds like a quarrel.
strings.课本能把两捆湿柴引旺（湿柴 −2，干柴 +2.2）: The textbooks will get two bundles of wet wood burning (wet wood −2, dry wood +2.2)
strings.谁也不走，请他直接去大堤叫冲锋舟: No one leaves; ask him to go straight to the dike and call an assault boat
strings.谁也别争，听天由命: No arguing; leave it to fate
strings.谁也听不到，好消息也听不到: No one hears it - and no good news either
strings.调查组只认名字；德厚要是知道了，会跟你拼命: The investigation team only goes by names; if Dennis finds out, he will fight you
strings.调查组来过两次，问的都是那天夜里带人去压沙袋的人。赵永福后来调到乡里管民政，逢年: The investigation team came twice, always asking about the man who took people to pile sandbags that night. Eugene Zhao was later transferred to the township to handle civil affairs, and every holiday he visited the flooded households - except the Chens. He never once dared go there.
strings.费点力气，免得水更脏: A bit of effort, to keep the water from getting filthier
strings.赌房子不会全塌: Bet that the house will not come down entirely
strings.走。房子是死的，人是活的: Go. A house is dead; people are alive.
strings.赵永福上了大堤以后，就再没有消息传回来。: After Eugene Zhao got to the dike, no word of him ever came back.
strings.赵永福后来在全乡的抗洪表彰大会上发了言，讲他怎么挨家挨户敲锣、怎么把陈奶奶背上楼: Eugene Zhao later spoke at the township's flood-fighting commendation meeting, telling how he had gone door to door with the gong and carried Grandma Chen up the stairs. The applause was loud. When he finished his script and stepped down, both his legs were shaking.
strings.赵永福张了张嘴，最后什么也没辩解。: Eugene Zhao opened his mouth, and in the end argued nothing.
strings.赵永福把 {actor} 拉到一边，压低了声音：“老陈，这事传出去，我这辈子就完: Eugene Zhao drew {actor} aside and lowered his voice: 'Old Chen, if this gets out, my life is finished. Once we are out, I will find a way to report your losses higher.'
strings.赵永福死在了屋顶上。管涌的事传开以后，他的追悼会没有开成。他老婆从县城回来，一个: Eugene Zhao died on the roof. After the business of the piping got around, his memorial service was never held. His wife came back from the county town and burned a stack of paper alone on the new dike at the breach, and passersby went around her.
strings.赵永福死在了屋顶上，到最后也没说出管涌的事。乡里给他开了追悼会，说他'为抢救群众: Eugene Zhao died on the roof, and to the end he never said a word about the piping. The township held a memorial service for him and called it a death in the rescue of the masses. A stone was later put up on that stretch of the new dike, with no name on it, and no mention of the three days before the breach.
strings.赵永福脸色发白，咬死了说那是“渗水”，不是管涌。: Eugene Zhao went pale and insisted to the last that it was 'seepage,' not piping.
strings.赵永福被赶下了屋顶。后来有人说在县城车站见过他，背着一个帆布包，买了一张去广州的: Eugene Zhao was driven off the roof. Someone later said they saw him at the county bus station with a canvas bag, buying a ticket to Guangzhou. No one from Yongfeng Polder ever saw him again.
strings.起瘟的是脏水，不是死人；只是天热，大家心里难受: It's dirty water that breeds disease, not the dead; it's just hard on everyone in this heat
strings.趁它还活着，宰了吃肉: Slaughter it for meat while it is still alive
strings.趁柴还干，把能装水的都烧满开水: While the firewood's still dry, boil water and fill every container
strings.趁雨还没下来，赶紧加固房子: Reinforce the house before the rain comes
strings.跳下去，把他拖回来: Jump in and drag him back
strings.跳水游向门口那棵大樟树: Jump in and swim for the big camphor tree by the door
strings.身上一下就凉了；血吸虫的事，要一两个月以后才知道: The body cools at once; whether it was the blood flukes will not be known for a month or two
strings.轮流守夜，拿竹竿和扁担把爬上来的蛇挑下去: Keep watch in turns, and use bamboo and shoulder poles to flick the snakes climbing up back down
strings.这一夜挑下去七八条蛇。天亮时，每个人的眼睛都熬得通红。: That night seven or eight snakes were flicked back down. By dawn every eye was red from lack of sleep.
strings.这一走，屋里的东西就由它去了: Once you leave, everything in the house is on its own
strings.这一轮渴得受不了、喝了生洪水的人数（只用来写日志）。: The number this round who were too thirsty to bear it and drank raw floodwater (used only for the log).
strings.这个承诺以后可能要兑现: You may have to make good on this promise later
strings.这件事会一直压在心上: This will weigh on your heart forever
strings.这件事又被搁下了。: And so it was set aside again.
strings.这场雨能接满一缸干净水: This rain can fill a whole vat of clean water
strings.这是一栋八十年代末盖的砖混房，用的是石灰砂浆。泡在水里的砖墙一天比一天酥，水越深: This is a brick-and-concrete house put up in the late eighties, laid with lime mortar. Brick walls in water go softer by the day, and the deeper the water and the rougher the waves, the faster the damage. Once integrity drops to around forty percent the walls crack, and after that it can come down at any moment. Reinforcement only buys time.
strings.这是我一砖一瓦砌起来的屋，我不走。: 'I built this house brick by brick, and I am not leaving.'
strings.这栋两层小楼是他 1989 年攒了十年的钱、自己一块砖一块砖砌起来的，是全家的命: He built this two-story little house in 1989 with ten years of savings, brick by brick with his own hands, and it is the family's lifeline. The pig tied on the stairs was to be sold to pay his daughter's university tuition. He swims well, he is stubborn as they come, and at home his word is law.
strings.这水里有血吸虫，莫光着脚在里头蹚，莫拿手去捧。: 'There are blood flukes in this water. Don't wade in it barefoot, and don't scoop it up with your hands.'
strings.远处一条冲锋舟上有人喊：大堤上跑上来好几头猪，有一头脖子上还拴着半截绳子。德厚愣: Someone on an assault boat shouted in the distance: several pigs had run up onto the dike, and one still had half a rope around its neck. Dennis was stunned for a moment, then broke into a grin.
strings.远处传来马达声！一条冲锋舟在几百米外的树梢间穿行，正往别处开。: A motor, far off! An assault boat was threading the treetops a few hundred meters away, heading somewhere else.
strings.远处传来马达声，越来越近——有船看见这里了！: A motor sounded in the distance, coming closer - a boat had seen this place!
strings.选一个水性最好的人游过去: Choose the strongest swimmer to go
strings.那几夜，房梁上的老鼠比人睡得还踏实。: For the next few nights the rats on the beams sleep more soundly than the people.
strings.那包吃的和那壶水，不知道他们最后吃上了没有。: That packet of food and that kettle of water - no one knows whether they ever got them.
strings.那天抢在老人和孩子前头上了船的人，在大堤上等了一整夜，谁也没合眼。这一场水里活下: Those who rushed aboard ahead of the old people and the children waited all night on the dike, and no one closed their eyes. Those who lived through the flood: {survivors}. Those who never came out: {dead}. Later, in the tents on the dike, those who had gone first spoke little to anyone. Asking about that day got one answer: 'There was no room on the boat.'
strings.那头猪是在镇上收购站卖的，四百二十块。德厚把钱用手绢包了三层，压在箱底。那年冬天: That pig was sold at the purchasing station in town for four hundred and twenty yuan. Dennis wrapped the money in a handkerchief, three layers, and pressed it into the bottom of a chest. That winter he cast a ring beam into the second-floor wall, carrying the cement up sack by sack, and told everyone he met: 'Nine days in the water and it never came down. This time it is even stronger.'
strings.那头猪饿得直哼哼，一下一下地拱着楼梯扶手。德厚抓了一把米，又看了看大家。: The pig was so hungry it grunted without stop, nosing at the stair rail again and again. Dennis took a handful of rice, and looked at the others.
strings.那年九月开学，武汉那所大学的新生名单上，一直留着小雨的名字。有个辅导员照着档案上: That September, when school started, Rainie's name was still on the freshman roster of the university in Wuhan. A counselor wrote three letters to the address in her file, and all three came back - that address was already under water.
strings.那年秋天，马向东背着一卷铺盖回了四川。村里人说起他，只记得他'会水还装旱鸭子'。: That autumn Sean Ma went back to Sichuan with his bedroll on his back. When the village speaks of him, all they remember is that he 'could swim but played the landlubber.' No one brought up the two hundred yuan again, and no one ever said sorry to him.
strings.那张盖着红章的纸在火里卷了起来。小雨扑过去抢，被她妈死死抱住了。: The paper with the red seal curled up in the flames. Rainie lunged for it, and her mother held her back with both arms.
strings.那条船突然掉过头来——他们看见了！: The boat suddenly swung around - they had seen them!
strings.部队冲锋舟在这片水域的搜救力度。头两天船都在抢险和救集镇，之后越来越多。: The search effort of the army's assault boats in these waters. For the first two days the boats are at the dike and the market town, then more and more.
strings.里里外外一把手，伺候瘫痪的婆婆两年了。年轻时在大队卫生室帮过几年忙，会打针、会包: She runs the house inside and out, and has nursed her paralyzed mother-in-law for two years. In her youth she helped for a few years at the brigade clinic; she can give injections and dress wounds, and she knows raw water has to be boiled before anyone drinks it.
strings.铝壶里的水滚了，剪子和一团棉线在里面翻着。有人把袖子挽到了胳膊肘。: The water in the aluminum kettle came to a boil, with the scissors and a coil of cotton thread turning in it. Someone rolled their sleeves up to the elbow.
strings.门板、塑料桶、尼龙绳，所有人围着筏子忙到了天黑。: Door plank, plastic jugs, nylon rope: everyone worked around the raft until dark.
strings.门板擦着屋角漂了过去。那个兵抬起头看了这边一眼，没有喊。: The door plank skimmed past the corner of the house. The soldier on it lifted his head and looked this way, and did not shout.
strings.陈奶奶又活了三年。那口刷了三遍桐油的寿材扎了筏子，后来不知漂到了哪里。走之前，家: Grandma Chen lived another three years. The coffin, coated three times with tung oil, became the raft, and drifted off to no one knows where. Before she went, the family got her a new one; she ran her hand over the boards and mumbled: 'This one... won't row far.'
strings.陈奶奶后来住进了镇上的移民新村，每天被人推到门口晒太阳。有人跟她提起那年发大水，: Grandma Chen later moved into the resettlement village by the town, and every day someone wheeled her out to the doorway to sit in the sun. When people mentioned the year of the great flood, she would recite slowly: 'It was like this in 1931 too. The water went down, and we were still here.'
strings.陈奶奶没能等到船。她给的那个手绢包，小雨一直揣在怀里，揣到了武汉。一百七十三块零: Grandma Chen didn't live to see a boat. Rainie carried the handkerchief bundle inside her shirt all the way to Wuhan. She never spent a note of the hundred and seventy-three yuan — on registration day she tucked them inside her admission letter.
strings.陈奶奶没能等到船。她走得很安静，像是睡着了。后来收拾她的竹床，在枕头底下摸出一个: Grandma Chen did not live to see a boat. She went quietly, as if falling asleep. Later, tidying her bamboo cot, they found a handkerchief bundle under the pillow: a hundred and seventy-three yuan in small change, tied with a red string - it was what she had saved for Rainie's university.
strings.陈家的人先走；外人会怎么想，顾不上了: The Chens go first; what outsiders think no longer matters
strings.陈德厚家的两层小楼是垸子里少有的楼房。村主任赵永福、借住在楼下偏房的四川砖匠马向: The two-story house of Dennis Chen's family was one of the few buildings of any height in the polder. Eugene Zhao, the village head, and Sean Ma, the Sichuan bricklayer lodging in the side room downstairs, had both fled here; Grandma Chen, paralyzed in bed, had been carried up on someone's back, and the family's yellow mongrel, Goldie, had scrambled up after them. The cookhouse and the grain store below were drowned; only the 150-jin pig, tied by Dennis to the stair rail, kept its head above water and squealed and squealed.
strings.随它去，狗命硬: Let it be; dogs are tough
strings.隐忍、要强、记仇；被人冤枉了也不争辩，只是闷着；对老人和小孩很好；真被逼到墙角会: Long-suffering, proud, and one to hold a grudge; wrongfully accused, he does not argue, he just goes quiet; he is good to the old and the young; and when he is truly cornered, he explodes.
strings.隔壁周家是平房，水已经快漫过屋檐。周家爷爷站在屋脊上，把九岁的孙子小军举过头顶，: The Zhou family next door lived in a one-story house, and the water was nearly over its eaves. Grandpa Zhou stood on the roof ridge with his nine-year-old grandson Jimmy held above his head, shouting across: 'Have a heart! Take the boy! He can swim, he just cannot swim that far!' Thirty-odd meters of fast water lay between the two houses.
strings.隔壁周家的孙子: The grandson of the Zhou family next door
strings.隔壁湾子张家的媳妇，怀孕八个多月: The Zhangs' daughter-in-law from the next bend, more than eight months pregnant
strings.顺着她，少给她一点水: Humour her and give her less water
strings.顾不上了，先顾自己: No time for that; look after yourself first
strings.顾不上了，拿洪水涮涮剪子就接: No time for that; rinse the scissors in floodwater and deliver the baby
strings.顾不上别人了，装作没听见: No time for anyone else; pretend not to have heard
strings.马向东一个猛子扎下去，几下就游到了小雨身边，夹着她游了回来。屋顶上的人半天没说出: Sean Ma dived in and was at Rainie's side in a few strokes, then swam back with her under one arm. No one on the roof could speak for a long moment.
strings.马向东一拳砸在墙上，转身上了屋顶，一整天没下来。: Sean Ma slammed his fist against the wall, turned, and went up to the roof; he did not come down all day.
strings.马向东回四川前，在砖瓦厂结了最后一个月的工钱，一张一张数了两遍。那两百块钱的事，: Before Sean Ma went back to Sichuan, he collected his last month's wages at the brick and tile yard and counted the notes twice, one by one. About the two hundred yuan he never said a word, even as he left - he had known all along who took it.
strings.马向东在水底下憋了快一分钟，冒出头来的时候气都不喘。德厚盯着他看了很久。: Sean Ma stayed under for nearly a minute, and came up without even breathing hard. Dennis stared at him for a long time.
strings.马向东没能回四川。砖瓦厂的工头把他最后一个月的工钱寄回了嘉陵江边的老家，汇款单的: Sean Ma never made it back to Sichuan. The foreman at the brick and tile yard sent his last month's wages to his family on the Jialing, and left the remarks line on the money order blank.
strings.马向东的遗物只有一个蛇皮袋：两件汗衫，一把砖刀，一张写着嘉陵江边地址的纸条。后来: All Sean Ma left behind was a woven plastic sack: two undershirts, a bricklayer's trowel, and a slip of paper with an address on the Jialing. Someone later sent four hundred yuan to that address, with a note that had just one line on it: 'It was not him who took the two hundred.'
strings.马达声渐渐听不见了。有人把头埋进了膝盖。: The sound of the motor slowly faded. Someone buried their head in their knees.
strings.马达声由远及近——一条迷彩色的冲锋舟拐过树梢，停在了屋边。船头的战士扯着嗓子喊：: The motor came closer and closer - a camouflage assault boat rounded the treetops and stopped by the house. The soldier in the bow shouted at the top of his voice: 'Nine on board already! Three more, no more! The rest wait for the next run - I will be back before dark!'
strings.黄水是擦掉了，可洪水里的东西，也擦进了伤口里。: The yellow fluid is wiped away — and whatever is in the floodwater is wiped into the wound.
strings.黄连素是止泻的；氟哌酸也许管一点用: Berberine is for diarrhoea; the norfloxacin might help a little
strings.黑夜里不一定有船；喊来了船，她和伢都有救: There may be no boats in the dark; but shout one over, and both she and the baby are saved
strings.（万长水拿桨把一只顺着电线爬过来的老鼠拨进水里）水一淹，田里的老鼠都往高处跑。屋: (Charles Wan flicks a rat off the electric wire into the water with his oar) When the fields flood, every rat heads for high ground. Keep everything in the house covered.
strings.（万长水眯着眼看了半天上游）这一拨水，比前头那一拨还要大。: (Charles Wan squints upstream for a long while) This lot's coming bigger than the last.
strings.（两只手捂着肚子，小声说）伢在里头踢我，踢得可有劲了。: (both hands over her belly, in a small voice) The baby's kicking me. Kicking hard, too.
strings.（冲着屋檐边的水面低吼，背上的毛一根根竖了起来——水里有东西在游。）: (growling low at the water by the eaves, the hair on his back standing up - something is swimming out there.)
strings.（半夜缩在被单里，小声地喊）爷爷……: (in the middle of the night, huddled under the sheet, calling softly) Grandpa...
strings.（叼回来一只淹死的老鼠，放在德厚脚边，摇了摇尾巴。）: (he brings back a drowned rat and lays it at Dennis's feet, wagging his tail.)
strings.（含含糊糊地念叨）民国二十年发大水，也是这样……水退了，人还在。: (mumbling) In 1931, when the great flood came, it was the same... The water went down, and we were still here.
strings.（往手心啐了口唾沫，又攥紧了桨）两天了，送了四十几个人，数不清了。: (spits in his palm, grips the oar again) Two days now, forty-some people ferried, I have lost count.
strings.（把下巴搁在奶奶的竹床沿上，眼睛跟着每一个人转来转去。）: (chin propped on the edge of Grandma's bamboo cot, eyes following everyone who moves.)
strings.（把干裂的嘴唇抿了又抿，摇着头推开递过来的水碗）: (presses her cracked lips together again and again, shakes her head, and pushes the water bowl away)
strings.（把给伢缝的小褂子摊在膝盖上，一点一点地晾干）: (spreads the little jacket she sewed for the baby on her knees and dries it, bit by bit)
strings.（挤在仅有的一小块阴凉里，舌头吐得老长，肚皮一鼓一鼓的。）: (crowded into the one small patch of shade, tongue hanging long, belly rising and falling.)
strings.（盯着上游看了很久）也不知道小李他们几个，被冲到哪儿去了。: (stares upstream for a long time) No idea where Young Li and the others got swept to.
strings.（眯着眼看了看天）今晚有大风，船走不得。: (squints at the sky) Big wind tonight. The boat cannot go out.
strings.（趴在屋檐边数漂过去的东西）一个西瓜，两个西瓜，一头猪……: (sprawled at the edge of the eaves, counting what floats past) One watermelon, two watermelons, a pig...
strings.（远处一有马达声，耳朵就立起来，跑到屋顶边上冲那边叫。）: (the moment a motor sounds in the distance, his ears go up, and he runs to the edge of the roof to bark at it.)
